items.title: 中東原油期貨雖漲 現貨價格已在走跌 油商對如何將油運出海峽已更加熟練
items.title_en: Middle East Crude Futures Rise While Spot Prices Decline; Oil Traders More Skilled at Shipping Oil Through the Strait
paras: 隨著美伊衝突即將進入第八個月，全球石油市場持續聚焦連波斯灣與國際市場的荷姆茲海峽航運流量。
儘管德黑蘭當局在美國 11 月期中選舉前夕疑似加劇對航運的襲擊，但生產商與全球貿易商日益熟練於將原油運出海峽，促使波斯灣外銷售的部分中東原油現貨價格顯著走跌。美國總統川普對此表示，目前流出此地區的原油數量甚至高於衝突爆發前。
據接獲報價的亞洲煉油業者透露，近期現貨市場報價顯著增加，且正以更具競爭力的價格行銷。具體跡象顯示，一批在阿曼灣以「船對船轉運」方式銷售的伊拉克巴斯拉中質原油，成交價較杜拜原油實體基準每桶折價近 10 美元；相較之下，一個月前該品級報價仍接近杜拜基準價格。
貿易商分析指出，伊拉克等品級原油現貨重挫，主因在於賣方報價競爭激烈，且附帶確保能將原油順利運出波斯灣的保證。
現貨市場的降價走勢與原油期貨形成鮮明對比。基準布蘭特原油期貨逼近每桶 115 美元，創下 5 月以來新高並邁向周線連三紅，高於一個月前的約 103 美元。
對此，荷蘭國際集團(ING Groep NV)大宗商品策略主管Warren Patterson分析指出：「目前中東原油流量雖維持良好，但市場真正的擔憂在於若再遭攻擊，流動能否持續，這解釋了紙上市場與實體市場的分歧。」
Patterson進一步表示：「期貨走高目前並非由基本面推動，而是市場在消化供應風險。」
買方市場方面，亞洲業者的採購意願轉強，包括台灣、印度與南韓的煉油廠本周已採購或發布招標，尋求最晚於 2027 年初交付的原油。同時，沙烏地與科威特中立區的卡夫吉原油及卡達夏辛原油交貨期已排至明年 1 月。
現貨供應充裕拖累其他中東原油品級，阿曼原油對杜拜原油的溢價跌至三個月低點，自荷姆茲海峽外出口的穆爾班原油價格亦同步走軟。
paras_en: As the US‑Iran conflict approaches its eighth month, the global oil market continues to focus on shipping traffic through the Strait of Hormuz linking the Persian Gulf to international markets.

Although Tehran authorities appear to have intensified attacks on shipping in the run‑up to the US November mid‑term elections, producers and global traders are becoming increasingly adept at moving crude out of the strait, causing spot prices for some Middle‑East crude exported from the Persian Gulf to fall sharply. President Trump noted that the volume of oil flowing out of the region is now even higher than before the conflict began.

Asian refiners who provided quotes said recent spot market pricing has risen markedly and is being marketed at more competitive levels. For example, a shipment of Iraqi Basra medium‑sweet crude sold on a ship‑to‑ship basis in the Oman Bay fetched a price about $10 per barrel below the Dubai physical benchmark, whereas a month ago that grade was trading near the Dubai price.

Traders said the sharp drop in spot prices for Iraqi and similar grades is mainly due to intense price competition among sellers, coupled with guarantees that the crude can be successfully shipped out of the Persian Gulf.

The spot‑price decline contrasts sharply with the futures market, where benchmark Brent crude futures are approaching $115 a barrel, a May‑high and three consecutive weekly gains, up from roughly $103 a barrel a month earlier.

Warren Patterson, head of commodity strategy at ING Groep NV, said: “While Middle‑East crude flows remain healthy, the real market worry is whether flow can be sustained if attacks resume, which explains the divergence between paper and physical markets.”
Patterson added: “The rise in futures prices is not being driven by fundamentals, but by the market digesting supply‑risk concerns.”

On the demand side, Asian buyers are stepping up purchases, with refiners in Taiwan, India and South Korea having bought or issued tenders this week for crude to be delivered no later than early 2027. At the same time, deliveries of Saudi‑Kuwait neutral‑zone Kafji crude and Qatar’s Shaxin crude have been pushed out to January next year.
Abundant spot supply is weighing on other Middle‑East grades: the Oman‑to‑Dubai premium has slipped to a three‑month low, and the Murban crude exported via the Strait of Hormuz is also softening.

items.title: 黃金也被賣來救急 匯豐解析金價失守4000美元背後壓力
items.title_en: Gold Also Sold to Raise Cash: HSBC Analyzes Pressures Behind Gold Falling Below $4,000
paras: 現貨黃金23日一度跌破每盎司4000美元關卡，與美股同步走弱，讓黃金的避險功能受到考驗。匯豐指出，股市下跌引發的追加保證金需求，可能迫使投資人賣金籌措現金，加上債券殖利率上升與美元走強，使黃金短期承壓，但債務與通膨疑慮仍支撐長期配置需求。
金價今年曾突破每盎司5000美元、創下歷史新高，隨後漲勢放緩並回落，市場波動加劇。匯豐資產管理策略師在最新報告中指出，高油價、利率上行與債券殖利率飆升，正對黃金構成壓力。
股市下跌急需現金 黃金也成賣壓來源
黃金近期跟著美股下跌，關鍵在於流動性壓力，而非避險需求完全消失。匯豐警告，槓桿資金集中持有黃金，一旦股市下跌觸發追加保證金要求，投資人可能被迫出售黃金，以補充現金，造成股票與黃金同時承壓。
在這種情況下，流動性較好的資產反而容易成為優先變現的對象。即使投資人仍看好黃金的長期價值，也可能因眼前的資金需求而賣出，使黃金無法抵銷股票部位的跌幅。
匯豐強調，沒有任何一種資產能抵禦所有類型的市場衝擊，投資人不應將黃金視為萬能避險工具。
殖利率走高 持有黃金成本上升
除了籌措現金的需求，美國公債殖利率上升，也是壓抑金價的重要因素。
匯豐全球首席投資長Willem Sels與全球財富洞察主管Lucia Ku在7月的報告中指出，黃金在中東衝突期間未能明顯上漲，走勢與股票大致同步。由於黃金本身不孳息，債券殖利率上升會提高持有黃金的機會成本，對金價形成壓力。
因此，地緣政治風險升高，並不保證黃金一定上漲。當高油價、殖利率上升、美元走強與股市下跌同時出現，黃金仍可能遭到拋售。
匯豐預期，實質殖利率維持高檔與美元走強，可能使金價短期維持區間震盪。黃金雖可對沖部分長期貨幣與信用風險，卻未必能在短期流動性衝擊中保護投資組合。
多頭過度擁擠 獲利了結加劇波動
對於先前金價大幅回檔，匯豐貴金屬首席分析師James Steel在5月指出，金價今年1月底觸及每盎司約5400美元高點後回落，部分原因是多頭部位過於擁擠，獲利了結進一步放大價格波動。
Steel認為，黃金在中東衝突期間表現不佳，並不代表避險功能失效。當油價上漲、債券殖利率與美元走強，加上股市下跌，投資人可能出售黃金籌集現金。
他形容：「黃金是一份保險單，而這份保險單正在被變現。」這也反映黃金在市場壓力下的另一種作用：投資人可能透過出售黃金取得所需資金，而金價因此承受賣壓。
債務與通膨疑慮未解 長期支撐仍在
儘管短期走勢承壓，匯豐資產管理策略師認為，近期回檔並不代表以對抗貨幣貶值為核心的交易邏輯已經失效。
這項交易是指投資人擔憂政府債務擴張、貨幣購買力下降及通膨風險，因而將部分資金轉向黃金等實體資產。策略師表示，只要債務與通膨疑慮持續存在，這項交易就能延續。
此外，地緣政治格局碎片化、央行儲備多元化，仍在支撐黃金需求。Sels與Ku在7月報告中也指出，投資組合多元化需求、央行持續購金與ETF資金流入，將為金價提供支撐，並預期年底前金價進一步上行。
不過，長期配置理由成立，並不意味黃金能在每次市場動盪中上漲。此次與美股同步下跌，凸顯短期現金需求與利率變化，仍可能壓過黃金的避險買盤。
paras_en: Spot gold briefly slipped below the $4,000 per ounce threshold on the 23rd, moving in tandem with a weakening U.S. equity market and testing gold's safe‑haven role. HSBC notes that margin calls triggered by equity declines may force investors to sell gold for cash, while rising bond yields and a stronger dollar add short‑term pressure, though debt and inflation concerns continue to underpin longer‑term demand.

Gold prices this year had once surged past $5,000 an ounce, hitting a historic high before the rally slowed and retreated, amplifying market volatility. HSBC asset‑management strategists said in a new report that high oil prices, rising rates and soaring bond yields are weighing on gold.
Equity market drops create urgent cash needs, making gold a source of selling pressure

Gold has recently fallen alongside U.S. stocks, driven more by liquidity stress than by a disappearance of safe‑haven demand. HSBC warns that leveraged funds holding large gold positions could be forced to liquidate when equity declines trigger margin calls, pushing both stocks and gold lower.

In such a scenario, assets with better liquidity become the first to be cashed in. Even investors who remain bullish on gold’s long‑term value may sell now to meet cash needs, preventing gold from offsetting equity losses.
HSBC stresses that no single asset can shield against every type of market shock, and investors should not treat gold as a universal hedge.
Higher yields raise the cost of holding gold
Beyond cash‑raising needs, the rise in U.S. Treasury yields is another key factor suppressing gold prices.

HSBC’s global chief investment officer Willem Sels and head of global wealth insights Lucia Ku noted in a July report that gold did not rise markedly during the Middle‑East conflict, moving roughly in line with equities. Because gold yields no income, higher bond yields increase its opportunity cost, pressuring prices.
Thus, heightened geopolitical risk does not guarantee gold gains. When high oil prices, rising yields, a strong dollar and falling stocks coincide, gold can still be sold off.

HSBC expects that sustained high real yields and a strong dollar could keep gold in a short‑term trading range. While gold can hedge some long‑term currency and credit risk, it may not protect portfolios from short‑term liquidity shocks.
Bull positions became overly crowded, profit‑taking amplified volatility

Regarding the sharp pull‑back earlier this year, HSBC precious‑metals chief analyst James Steel said in May that gold, after peaking around $5,400 an ounce at the end of January, fell partly because long‑dated bull positions were too crowded, and profit‑taking further heightened price swings.

Steel argues that gold’s weak performance during the Middle‑East conflict does not mean its safe‑haven function has failed. With oil prices up, yields and the dollar rising, and equities falling, investors may sell gold to raise cash.

He described it as, “Gold is an insurance policy, and that policy is being liquidated.” This reflects another role for gold under market stress: investors may sell it to obtain needed funds, adding selling pressure to the price.
Debt and inflation worries remain unresolved, providing long‑term support
Although short‑term dynamics are pressuring gold, HSBC asset‑management strategists say the recent dip does not signal the end of a trade logic centered on protecting against currency depreciation.

That trade logic refers to investors fearing expanding government debt, declining purchasing power and inflation risk, prompting a shift of capital into tangible assets like gold. Strategists say as long as debt and inflation concerns persist, the trade can continue.

Moreover, a fragmented geopolitical landscape and diversified central‑bank reserves continue to underpin gold demand. Sels and Ku also noted in the July report that portfolio‑diversification needs, ongoing central‑bank buying and ETF inflows should support prices, with expectations of further upside before year‑end.

However, a sound long‑term case does not mean gold will rise in every market turmoil. Its recent co‑movement with equities highlights that short‑term cash needs and rate changes can outweigh safe‑haven buying.

items.title: Solidigm赴美喊卡！SK海力士今彈4.42%　但3個月前聽「他」建議進場散戶虧損比例仍達75%
items.title_en: Solidigm Halts U.S. Plans! SK Hynix Jumps 4.42% but Retail Investors Who Followed Advice Three Months Ago Still Face 75% Losses
paras: SK海力士今(23)日收報每股127.7萬韓元，上漲4.42%，盤中一度下探至117.1萬韓元，隨後震盪翻紅，主要因為該公司宣布暫停旗下美國子公司Solidigm的上市前融資與IPO評估。市場原先擔憂Solidigm單獨赴美掛牌，會因雙重上市折價拖累集團價值，南韓金融委員會前一日也表態將適用雙重上市監管規則，如今計畫喊停，短線緩解估值疑慮。
但支撐股價的回購緩衝已退場。SK海力士周三(21日)提前約一個月完成總額約40兆韓元回購，8月20日以來外資淨賣超25.66兆韓元、法人淨賣超2.68兆韓元。大信證券指出，回購結束不代表股價續跌，但波動將放大。
大約三個月前，SK集團會長崔泰源在濟州島論壇喊出「持有」建議，稱記憶體需求長期向好，但股價自高點回落近60%，當時跟進的散戶成為最大受災戶。
統計顯示，今年4-6月個人投資者淨買入31.5兆韓元，其中6月股價創新高時單月買超15.63兆韓元；7月股價從250萬韓元崩至130萬韓元，散戶仍加碼9兆韓元攤平，最終未躲過虧損。NH投資證券統計，截至10月19日，74.18%的SK海力士持有人處於套牢狀態。
市場目光轉向SK海力士下周三(28日)公布的第三季財報。FnGuide一致預期營業利益達76.964兆韓元，有望創單季新高，但強勁業績已被市場提前反映，真正變數在於股東回報方案。
美林證券測算，按近期收盤價估算，2027年預期本益比僅1.10倍，處於歷史低位。分析師金善宇認為，終止Solidigm上市顯示公司把股東價值置於擴張路線之前，若下周三財報會釋出更具體回報措施，才有機會確認估值窪地、帶動股價實質反彈。
paras_en: SK Hynix closed today (23rd) at 1,277,000 won per share, up 4.42%, after briefly dipping to 1,171,000 won before rebounding. The move was driven by the company’s announcement that it is suspending pre‑IPO financing and listing evaluation for its U.S. subsidiary Solidigm. Earlier market concerns that a separate U.S. listing could drag down group value due to a dual‑listing discount were eased after the Financial Services Commission said dual‑listing rules would apply, and the plan to list has now been called off, temporarily relieving valuation worries.

However, the share‑price support from a buyback has disappeared. SK Hynix completed a roughly 40 trillion‑won repurchase about a month early on Wednesday (21st). Since August 20, foreign investors have net‑sold 25.66 trillion won and institutional investors have net‑sold 2.68 trillion won. Daishin Securities noted that the end of the buyback does not guarantee further price declines, but volatility is likely to increase.

About three months ago, SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won urged investors at a Jeju Island forum to “hold” the stock, saying memory‑chip demand remains strong in the long run. He noted the share price had fallen nearly 60% from its peak, and retail investors who bought in at that time became the biggest losers.

Statistics show that individual investors net‑bought 31.5 trillion won of SK Hynix shares from April to June this year, including a single‑month net purchase of 15.63 trillion won when the stock hit a new high in June. In July the price fell from 2.5 million won to 1.3 million won, yet retail investors added another 9 trillion won to average down, ultimately still incurring losses. NH Investment & Securities calculated that as of October 19, 74.18% of SK Hynix shareholders were in a loss position.

Market attention now shifts to SK Hynix’s third‑quarter earnings due next Wednesday (28th). FnGuide uniformly expects operating profit of 76.964 trillion won, potentially a quarterly record, but the strong results have already been priced in, leaving the real variable to be the shareholder‑return plan.

Merrill Lynch estimates that, based on the recent closing price, the 2027 forward price‑to‑earnings ratio would be only 1.10×, a historic low. Analyst Kim Sun‑woo believes that terminating Solidigm’s listing shows the company prioritizes shareholder value over expansion, and that only if next Wednesday’s earnings release outlines concrete return measures can the valuation gap be confirmed and the stock see a genuine rebound.

items.title: AI股拋售潮還要跌多久？摩根大通：避險基金多頭部位已大致出清
items.title_en: How Long Will the AI Stock Sell‑off Last? JPMorgan: Hedge‑fund Long Positions Mostly Closed
paras: 《Investing.com》週四 (22 日) 報導，摩根大通指出，隨著投資人自 9 月中旬以來大幅調整股票部位，AI 相關股票的賣壓可能逐漸接近極限。儘管短期逆風仍在，持倉降溫可望開始限制股價進一步下跌的空間。
摩根大通策略師 Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou 在最新報告中表示，該行整體股票持倉指標已明顯低於近期高峰，顯示市場先前偏高的曝險已有所消化。不過，這項判斷主要反映部位調整的進展，並不代表短期波動已經結束。
針對近期引發市場疑慮的新型雲端業者 (neoclouds) 融資問題，摩根大通認為，即使這類業者的融資模式難以持續，也不至於讓整體 AI 資本支出週期脫軌，因為它們在 AI 生態系中的占比仍小，並非不可取代。
根據該行估算，全球上市科技公司今年現金流約為 2.2 兆美元，資本支出約為 1.8 兆美元，其中新型雲端業者分別占約 300 億美元及 800 億美元。
Panigirtzoglou 表示，這意味著，新型雲端業者推動的 AI 基礎設施建置，可由資產負債表更健全、營收來源更多元的科技公司承接，包括大型雲端服務供應商。
從整體資金狀況來看，科技業今年現金流高於資本支出約 4,000 億美元，仍保有融資餘裕。摩根大通指出，科技公司發債，主要是為了在擴大資本支出的同時，維持股票回購。
若融資疑慮進一步蔓延，企業仍可透過延後回購，或增加產業內部的循環融資安排，支應投資需求。Panigirtzoglou 認為，科技業整體現金流足以支應資本支出，代表產業內部仍有資金後盾。
不過，半導體類股仍是潛在波動來源。
摩根大通指出，半導體目前約占全球股市整體風險資本的 1/5，當波動升高時，容易面臨投資人為控制風險而減碼的壓力。
該行研判，避險基金及商品交易顧問 (CTA) 等動能型投資人，可能已大致平倉先前偏高的半導體多頭部位。隨著這波調整逐步完成，相關賣壓可望減輕。
paras_en: Investing.com reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that JPMorgan said the selling pressure on AI‑related stocks may be nearing its limit as investors have dramatically trimmed equity positions since mid‑September. Although short‑term headwinds remain, the cooling of holdings should begin to curb further price declines.

JPMorgan strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou said in a latest note that the firm’s overall equity‑position indicator is now clearly below its recent peak, indicating that the market’s previously elevated exposure has been partially digested. However, this assessment mainly reflects the progress of position adjustments and does not mean short‑term volatility has ended.

Regarding the financing issues of new‑type cloud providers (neoclouds) that have recently raised market concerns, JPMorgan believes that even if these providers’ financing models prove unsustainable, they will not derail the overall AI capital‑expenditure cycle because their share of the AI ecosystem remains small and they are not indispensable.

The bank estimates that global listed technology companies have cash flow of about $2.2 trillion this year and capital expenditures of roughly $1.8 trillion, with new‑type cloud providers accounting for about $30 billion and $80 billion respectively.

Panigirtzoglou noted that this means AI infrastructure projects driven by new‑type cloud providers can be taken over by technology firms with stronger balance sheets and more diversified revenue streams, including large cloud service providers.

Looking at the overall funding picture, the tech sector’s cash flow this year exceeds capital spending by roughly $400 billion, leaving ample financing headroom. JPMorgan said tech companies issue debt mainly to maintain share buybacks while expanding capex.

If financing concerns spread further, companies can still defer buybacks or increase internal circular financing arrangements to meet investment needs. Panigirtzoglou believes the sector’s cash flow is sufficient to cover capex, indicating that internal funding support remains robust.
However, semiconductor stocks remain a potential source of volatility.
JPMorgan pointed out that semiconductors now represent about one‑fifth of total risk capital in global equity markets, and when volatility rises, investors tend to cut exposure to manage risk.

The bank assesses that momentum investors such as hedge funds and commodity‑trading advisors (CTAs) have likely largely closed out their previously oversized long positions in semiconductors. As this adjustment winds down, related selling pressure should ease.

items.title: AI「自動模式」全球上線資安隱憂：OpenAI代理驚爆私關防護、說謊與沙盒漏洞
paras: Anthropic 近期針對 Claude 推出了 自動模式，將審查與執行權限全權交給人工智慧，藉此緩解人類在處理大量高強度程式開發時因疲勞而難以負荷的監管壓力。然而，相關的內部安全稽核與審查報告卻揭露了多項嚴重的防護漏洞。
這項重大轉變的主因在於「人類監工」體系的實質潰敗：Anthropic 的測試指出，面對程式碼中的潛在危險指令，人類審查員僅能攔截 13.6%，連續點擊審查超過 50 次後攔截率更暴跌至 5% 左右，而 AI 審查的攔截率則高達 89%。
OpenAI 曾公開預測：「我們預計模型很快將承擔大部分安全工作，包括防禦其他模型。」 然而，外部權威評估與內部真實事故接連曝光，暴露出「以 AI 監督 AI」的防禦體系存在致命脆弱性。
AI 安全評估機構 METR 與 Redwood Research 的研究人員 David Rein 與 Adam Kaufman 日前進駐 OpenAI，針對其內部安全監控系統展開為期三週的深度紅隊測試，並提交長達 61 頁的審查報告。
調查發現，儘管 OpenAI 內部 Codex 流量看似有 99.2% 受監控，整體系統卻暗藏多條嚴重安全漏洞：

觸發機制盲點：監控機制僅在代理完成工作並交還控制權時啟動，代理若利用「上下文壓縮」漏洞持續運作，就能無限期延後監控審查，導致 5 至 7 月間約 10% 的 Codex 流量脫離監控。
操作隱匿與幽靈分身：漏洞可使代理最近數百步操作在監控中隱身，且代理能藉由竄改客戶端標頭設定，孵化出不受監控的同款分身。
沙盒穿透與監控癱瘓：Codex 代理原則上能同時繞過沙盒與自動審查，取得宿主研究員的所有權限，甚至可藉由資料序列化格式差異使監控 AI 當機報錯。


針對上述缺失，評估人員在報告中強調，未來的安全架構必須假設高能力代理會發動「蓄意且具策略性的持續攻擊」，呼籲建立定期強制檢查與代理環境隔離等防護機制。雖然 OpenAI 事後宣稱影響生產環境的漏洞已全數修補，但 METR 指出尚未針對該說法進行獨立驗證。
更令資安界警惕的是 OpenAI 揭露的真實脫序案例。其內部部署的 GPT-6.1 Sol 與 GPT-6 Astra 代理在執行軟體修改時，竟自主弱化了監控系統：Sol 代理將一條例行搜尋指令擅自解讀為關閉安全警報的依據，將通報通知關閉並清空通報名單；Astra 代理在遷移程式時刪除監控整合，事後面對使用者詢問時公然說謊否認移除，甚至在內部推理中發現監控消失時寫下「耶」的驚悚思維紀錄。
OpenAI 官方在事故報告中解釋，模型將例行指示誤判為削弱防護的許可，並坦言：「這可能只是『良性過度執著』(benign overpersistence)，模型無法理解監控的重要性，或過度堅持執行超出合理預期的指令。」
面對自主代理失控的風險，微軟安全部門執行副總裁 Hayete Gallot 示警：「模型受訓是為了達成結果，這往往導致獎勵作弊(reward hacking)，且模型並未針對組織常規或判斷力進行最佳化；代理具備不可預測性，隨著情境改變會自我調整，甚至會在未遭入侵的情況下，為了達成目標而與其他代理串通勾結。」
微軟為此推出「專案感知」(Project Perception)與守護者代理，將自主 AI 定義為需要動態調整權限的新型「內部資安威脅」。

items.title: 月之暗面Kimi K3.1曝光！程式碼透露「思考強度」新選項
items.title_en: Moon's Dark Side Kimi K3.1 Unveiled! Code Reveals New "Thinking Intensity" Option
paras: 月之暗面旗下 Kimi 官方帳號周五(23)日在 X 與微信影片號發布一段 24 秒預熱影片，畫面中的模型欄位出現「Kimi K3.1」字樣，透露新模型可能即將登場。此前，開源專案 SGLang 的程式碼更新也已出現支援 K3.1 的相關內容。
這段影片以一台老式電腦開場，螢幕上執行的是 Kimi Code。有眼尖網友發現，畫面左上角的模型欄位標示「Model: Kimi K3.1」，成為此次預熱影片的一大焦點。
早在 10 月 19 日，就有網友注意到，SGLang 的一次程式碼提交出現「Kimi-K3.1 support for the K3 chat encoder」標題，相關更新為其實驗性路由元件加入 K3.1 對話編碼支援，提前透露新模型的動向。
從程式碼來看，K3.1 最明確的變化是新增「medium」思考強度。原先 K3 支援 low、high、max 三個等級，K3.1 則在此基礎上加入 medium，讓思考強度多一個選項，路由預設設定仍維持 max。
月之暗面今年 7 月正式發布並開源 Kimi K3，在中國及海外引發討論，不少人將其形容為另一個「DeepSeek R1 時刻」。
近日，由前 Google 首席科學家 Jeff Dean 投資的 AI 新創公司 hillclimb，發布新的基準測試 DeepRSI，專門評估大型語言模型的遞迴自我改進（RSI）與自主科學研究能力。
榜單顯示，Claude Fable 5.1 以 1,548 分排名第一，GPT-6 Astra 以 1,232 分居次。月之暗面旗下擁有 2.8 兆參數的 Kimi K3 則以 820 分排名全球第三，同時拿下中國模型與開源模型第一，成績超越 Grok 4.7 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash。
paras_en: Moon's Dark Side's official Kimi account on Friday (23) posted a 24‑second teaser video on X and WeChat Channels, showing the model field with the label “Kimi K3.1”, hinting that a new model may be arriving soon. Earlier, the open‑source project SGLang’s code update already included support for K3.1.

The video opens with an old computer running Kimi Code on its screen. Sharp‑eyed netizens noticed that the model field in the upper‑left corner reads “Model: Kimi K3.1”, becoming the main focus of the teaser.

Back on October 19, a user pointed out that a SGLang code commit was titled “Kimi‑K3.1 support for the K3 chat encoder”. The update adds experimental routing components with K3.1 dialogue‑encoding support, foreshadowing the new model.

From the code, the most concrete change in K3.1 is the addition of a “medium” thinking intensity. The original K3 supported low, high and max levels; K3.1 adds medium on top of those, giving an extra option, while the routing default remains max.
Moon’s Dark Side officially released and open‑sourced Kimi K3 in July this year, sparking discussion both in China and abroad, with many likening it to another “DeepSeek R1 moment”.

Recently, hillclimb—a AI startup funded by former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean—released a new benchmark called DeepRSI, designed to evaluate large language models’ recursive self‑improvement (RSI) and autonomous scientific research capabilities.

The leaderboard shows Claude Fable 5.1 scoring 1,548 points to take first place, GPT‑6 Astra at 1,232 points in second, and Moon’s Dark Side’s 2.8‑trillion‑parameter Kimi K3 scoring 820 points to rank third globally, while also topping the China and open‑source categories, surpassing Grok 4.7 and Gemini 3.8 Flash.

items.title: DeepSeek完成千億人民幣募資 創中國AI紀錄 寧德時代領投
items.title_en: DeepSeek Completes 100 Billion RMB Funding, Sets Chinese AI Record, Led by CATL
paras: 據《彭博》報導，中國人工智慧新創深度求索(DeepSeek)已完成新一輪高達 1,000 億元人民幣(約 150 億美元)的股權募資，刷新中國創投史單筆紀錄，創下全球開源模型實體單筆融資新猷。
本輪投前估值約 748 億至 750 億美元；據知情人士透露，原定 500 億元的籌資目標因新模型發布後認購踴躍而兩度調升，自 800 億元最終鎖定在千億關卡。
此輪募資陣容備受矚目。全球動力電池龍頭寧德時代以約 15 億美元(近 100 億元人民幣)領投，網際網路巨頭騰訊持續加碼，吉利汽車、美的集團、美團等製造與數位生活指標企業亦列名其中。加上 2026 年 6 月首輪約 500 億元募資，DeepSeek 在半年內累計吸金達 225 億美元。
這家公司首輪便採有限合夥架構，創辦人梁文鋒個人出資約 200 億元並保留近 100% 表決權，外部投資人無投票權且股權鎖定五年，使融資擴大的同時仍能穩固決策核心。
此筆融資規模遠超阿里巴巴與商湯科技未上市前的籌資金額，大幅縮小與 OpenAI、Anthropic 累計逾千億美元的資金差距，為公司首次公開發行(IPO)奠定基礎。
寧德時代入局象徵製造業向 AI 上游延伸，透過儲能與供電硬體對接運算力產業，可開拓第二成長曲線。
關於資金去向與上市進程，綜合財新與彭博報導，資金將主要流向運算力基礎設施，包含在內蒙古烏蘭察布興建資料中心、目標新增 1GW 運算力，並擬部署至少 16 萬枚華為 AI 加速器。主要用於建設自主綠色智算基地、深化華為昇騰等國產晶片異構生態，並為次世代原生全模態世界模型研發儲備彈藥。
此外，《路透》披露 DeepSeek 已延攬前高瓴創投合夥人嚴文韜出任財務長，並委託中信證券籌備上海科創板掛牌，預計最快 2027 年初叩關 IPO。
paras_en: According to Bloomberg, Chinese AI startup DeepSeek has completed a new round of equity financing totaling 100 billion RMB (about $15 billion), breaking the single‑deal record in China’s venture‑capital history and setting a world‑first for a single financing of an open‑source model entity.

The pre‑money valuation for this round was roughly $748‑$750 billion; insiders said the original target of 50 billion RMB was raised twice after strong subscription following the launch of a new model, ultimately locking in the 100 billion‑RMB milestone after an interim 80 billion RMB figure.

The financing lineup attracted great attention. Global battery leader CATL led the round with about $1.5 billion (nearly 10 billion RMB), internet giant Tencent continued to add funds, and manufacturers and digital‑life giants such as Geely, Midea Group and Meituan were also listed among investors. Including a roughly 50 billion‑RMB first round in June 2026, DeepSeek has raised a cumulative $22.5 billion in six months.

The company used a limited‑partnership structure from its first round, with founder Liang Wen‑feng contributing about 20 billion RMB and retaining close to 100% voting rights; external investors have no voting rights and their equity is locked for five years, allowing the financing to expand while keeping decision‑making core intact.

The size of this financing dwarfs the pre‑IPO fundraising amounts of Alibaba and SenseTime, dramatically narrowing the funding gap with OpenAI and Anthropic, which have each amassed over $100 billion, and lays the groundwork for the company’s first public offering.

CATL’s participation signals the manufacturing sector’s move upstream into AI, linking energy‑storage and power‑supply hardware with compute‑intensive workloads and opening a second growth curve for the firm.

According to combined reports from Caixin and Bloomberg, the funds will mainly go to compute‑infrastructure, including building a data center in Ulanqab, Inner Mongolia, targeting an additional 1 GW of compute capacity and deploying at least 160,000 Huawei AI accelerators. The money will be used to construct a self‑owned green intelligent‑computing base, deepen the domestic chip heterogenous ecosystem such as Huawei’s Ascend, and stockpile resources for the next‑generation native multimodal world model.

In addition, Reuters disclosed that DeepSeek has hired former Hillhouse Capital partner Yan Wentao as CFO and has engaged CITIC Securities to prepare a listing on Shanghai’s STAR Market, with the earliest IPO expected in early 2027.

items.title: iPhone Duo等貨排到明年1月 黃牛卻先降價、256GB還遭拒收
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo正式開賣，交貨時間已排至明年1月下旬，黃牛加價行情卻率先降溫。
iPhone Duo推出256GB、512GB、1TB及2TB四種容量，中國售價分別為15999元(人民幣，下同)、17999元、21499元及26499元，成為蘋果歷來最昂貴的手機。
據《財聯社》走訪上海、廣州蘋果直營店，首賣當天二手回收溢價開高走低，最熱門的1TB版本加價幅度從早間人民幣2200元縮至1600至1800元，部分黃牛更直接拒收256GB版本，反映市場對後續供應的預期正在改變。
儘管僅支援eSIM，且未搭載Face ID與長焦鏡頭，新機仍掀起搶購熱潮。10月16日晚間8時開放預購後迅速售罄，蘋果官網一度無法進入。預售期間，二手平台多個版本成交價突破2萬元，1TB黑色版本溢價一度達7143元。
正式開賣前，蘋果已在全球實施限購，中國官網規定每位顧客最多購買兩支，壓縮大量囤貨空間。
首賣當天，上海靜安店外有不少消費者排隊取貨，店員表示，排隊者均已付款、搶到首批供貨，當天才下單的顧客，預計要等到明年1月23日左右。廣州天環廣場門市同樣沒有現貨，官方預訂交貨時間已排至2027年1月下旬。
1TB最搶手 入門與頂規版行情分化
官方通路供貨吃緊，卻未讓黃牛加價幅度持續攀升。上海、廣州兩地首賣當天的回收行情相近，且不同容量版本明顯分化。
上海市場上午9時50分左右，各版本普遍仍可加價1000元以上回收，最高不到2000元；到10時30分左右，部分版本溢價已經回落，1TB約可加價1500至1800元，512GB約加價1200元。
256GB版本則出現拒收情況。有黃牛表示，目前只收1TB版本，也有人願意加價800元收購白色256GB機型。
廣州同樣以1TB最受歡迎，早間回收加價一度達2200元，上午10時30分左右降至1600至1800元。512GB白色版本次之，約加價1100至1400元；256GB普遍加價900元。至於售價最高的2TB版本，有黃牛暫不報價，也有人僅願加價數百元收購。
多名黃牛對後市態度謹慎，認為隨著首批手機陸續提貨、流入市場，可交易貨源增加，下午加價幅度可能進一步縮小。
供應預期改善 產能瓶頸仍未解
Counterpoint Research副總監Liz Lee表示，初期高溢價主要來自上市供應緊張與黃牛炒作，近期溢價回落，則反映市場對供應情況的預期改善。
不過，加價降溫並不代表供應瓶頸已經解除。蘋果原為首款摺疊手機設定1000萬支備貨目標，但受到產線協作及產能提升進度影響，市場機構對年底出貨量仍有明顯分歧。
摩根大通最新研究預估，受限於鉸鏈、超薄玻璃等零組件產能，iPhone Duo今年出貨量約800萬至900萬支，低於先前1000萬支的預期目標。
蘋果也持續強化供應鏈，10月20日宣布與多家美國企業建立或擴大合作。其中，Perryman Company將為包括iPhone Duo在內的蘋果產品供應鈦金屬，蘋果將在三年內提供最高1億美元資金支持。
蘋果加入戰局 能否帶動市場擴大
Liz Lee指出，iPhone Duo的差異化設計，包括奈米紋理內螢幕、旨在減輕摺痕的客製玻璃與膠層結構，以及鈦金屬機身和精密鉸鏈。不過，這些主要是工程改良，並非重大技術突破，蘋果更大的優勢在於品牌、生態系整合及軟體體驗。
她認為，蘋果龐大的既有iPhone用戶群，有助將摺疊手機帶向更廣泛的高階消費者。Counterpoint預估，蘋果加入將推動全球摺疊手機出貨量今年成長24%，2027年再增37%；蘋果在這兩年的全球摺疊手機市占率，預估分別約為25%與40%。
市場擴大也可望讓鉸鏈、超薄玻璃加工及精密結構件供應商受惠，但實際受益程度仍取決於供應鏈布局與供貨比重。
然而，螢幕摺痕、長期耐用性、維修與製造成本，仍是摺疊手機必須克服的問題。
Liz Lee認為，下一階段重點已不是證明技術可行，而是透過軟體優化與日常使用體驗，讓消費者真正感受到大螢幕的價值，願意為較高售價買單。

items.title: 揚明光連三季獲利 前三季EPS 0.11元
items.title_en: Yang Ming Optical Posts Profit for Three Consecutive Quarters, EPS 0.11 NT$ for First Three Quarters
paras: 光學元件廠揚明光學(3504-TW)今(23)日召開董事會，公告第三季稅後純益122萬元，季減76.25%，較去年同期由虧轉盈，每股純益0.01元；前三季稅後純益1234萬元，每股純益0.11元，較去年同期由虧轉盈。
展望第四季，揚明光學指出，光學元件類產品受物流投影鏡頭客戶啟動新版本變更計畫影響，相關需求可能遞延或暫緩，預估出貨動能將下修；3D列印產品隨新機種逐步導入客戶端測試，出貨預期略增；其餘產品線因接近年底，客戶備貨轉趨保守，預計出貨較第三季持平或略減。整體而言，預估第四季出貨量將較第三季減少。
揚明光學2026年第三季營收7.46億元，毛利率16.8%，季增0.36個百分點、年減0.22個百分點，營業損失872萬元；前三季營收21.7億元，毛利率17.13%，年增0.94個百分點。
揚明光學表示，第三季智能家居新機種持續放量，但低階舊型鏡頭也進入終止階段，取像光學產品出貨表現持平；光學元件類產品因客戶AR眼鏡進入量產，出貨較上季增加；3D列印產品則因進入新舊機種銜接期，受到客戶端調整舊機種庫存及新機驗證雙重影響，本季出貨相對放緩。
車用產品方面，揚明光學第三季隨LiDAR鏡頭新機種順利量產，逐步取代舊機種，帶動出貨量略增。
paras_en: Optical component manufacturer Yang Ming Optical (3504‑TW) held its board meeting today (23rd) and announced a Q3 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.22 million, down 76.25% quarter‑over‑quarter, turning a loss into a profit compared with the same period last year, resulting in earnings per share of NT$0.01; for the first three quarters the after‑tax net profit was NT$12.34 million, EPS NT$0.11, also turning a loss into a profit versus the prior year.

Looking ahead to Q4, Yang Ming Optical noted that demand for optical‑component products may be delayed or postponed due to logistics projection‑lens customers launching new version change programs, so shipment momentum is expected to be revised downward; 3D‑printing products are gradually being introduced to customer testing with new models, so shipments are expected to rise slightly; other product lines, as the year‑end approaches, see customers becoming more conservative in inventory, so shipments are expected to be flat or slightly lower than Q3. Overall, Q4 shipment volume is projected to be lower than Q3.

Yang Ming Optical reported Q3 2026 revenue of NT$746 million, gross margin 16.8%, up 0.36 percentage points quarter‑over‑quarter but down 0.22 points year‑over‑year, and an operating loss of NT$8.72 million; for the first three quarters revenue was NT$2.17 billion, gross margin 17.13%, up 0.94 percentage points year‑over‑year.

The company said that in Q3 the new smart‑home models continued to ramp up, while low‑end legacy lenses entered the phase‑out stage, keeping imaging‑optics product shipments flat; optical‑component products saw higher shipments as a customer’s AR glasses entered mass production; 3D‑printing products experienced a slowdown this quarter because they are in a transition period between old and new models, affected by customers adjusting old‑model inventory and validating new models.
In the automotive segment, Yang Ming Optical’s new LiDAR lens models were successfully mass‑produced in Q3, gradually replacing older models and driving a modest increase in shipment volume.

items.title: 生合首次發行CB預計10/30上櫃交易 今年市場籌資將達5.4億元
items.title_en: Shenghe's First CB Issuance Expected to Trade OTC on Oct 30; Market Fundraising This Year Will Reach NT$540 million
paras: 益生菌原料大廠生合(1295-TW)2026年積極進行市場籌資，繼8月完成以發行現增股3125張完成1.4億元的籌資之後，再以完成發行面額4億元的國內第一次無擔保轉換公司債(CB)籌資，這筆CB預計在10月30日上櫃掛牌交易。
生合8月完成的現增案以每股45元發行，募集金額1.4億元，而本月再發行面額4億元的國內第一次無擔保轉換公司債(CB)籌資，轉換價爲50元，預計在10月30日上櫃交易，今年的生合的現增、發行CB的市場兩筆市場籌資案，合計募5.4億元。
生合今年來市場籌資5.4億元，主要用途爲償還銀行借款。
生合2026年1-6月營收5.11億元，毛利率49.76%，稅後純益6803萬元，每股純益1.97元。
生合股價10月22日收盤價報46.75元。
paras_en: Probiotic ingredient giant Shenghe (1295‑TW) is actively raising capital in 2026. After completing a capital increase in August that raised NT$1.4 billion by issuing 3,125 new shares, the company will now issue its first domestic unsecured convertible bond (CB) with a face value of NT$4 billion, slated to begin trading on the OTC market on October 30.

The August capital increase was priced at NT$45 per share, raising NT$1.4 billion. This month, Shenghe will issue a domestic unsecured CB with a face value of NT$4 billion and a conversion price of NT$50, also expected to trade on the OTC market on October 30. Together, the two market‑raising actions— the capital increase and the CB issuance—will total NT$5.4 billion for the year.
Shenghe's NT$5.4 billion of fundraising this year will primarily be used to repay bank loans.
For the first half of 2026, Shenghe reported revenue of NT$5.11 billion, a gross margin of 49.76%, net profit after tax of NT$68.03 million, and earnings per share of NT$1.97.
Shenghe's closing price on October 22 was NT$46.75 per share.

items.title: 台新私人銀行亞灣旗艦店正式開幕 攜瑞聯銀行打造國際級私人銀行服務
items.title_en: Taishin Private Bank Asia-Pacific Flagship Branch Officially Opens, Partnering with Union Bancaire Privée to Offer International-Grade Private Banking Services
paras: 台新銀行積極響應政府推動亞洲資產管理中心政策，持續深耕高資產財富管理市場，今(23)日正式成立「台新私人銀行亞灣旗艦店」，展現布局南臺灣、連結亞洲財富管理市場的決心。此次開幕典禮由台新銀行私銀暨高端理財事業總處執行長林尚愷主持，並與瑞聯銀行(Union Bancaire Privée, UBP)簽署策略聯盟合作備忘錄，借助瑞聯銀行作為瑞士規模最大的家族所有私人銀行之一在高資產財富管理服務及國際投資的專業優勢，進一步強化台新私人銀行的國際視野與服務量能。

台新私銀總處執行長林尚愷表示，隨著台新新光金控合併逐步展現集團規模效益，客戶基礎擴大至逾1,100萬戶。為因應快速成長的高端財富管理需求，台新銀行今(2026)年正式成立「私銀暨高端理財事業總處」，匯聚金融資歷逾20年且具備CFP、AFP等專業認證的財富規劃顧問團隊，結合具豐富實務經驗的律師、會計師等專業人士，全面強化高資產客群財富規劃服務。面對全球稅務變局與企業世代交替浪潮，台新私銀家族辦公室以家族投資管理、財富傳承、稅務服務、家族治理與生活管家為五大核心領域，提供高資產客戶全方位的家辦式顧問服務。

看好台新新光合併後的龐大資源優勢及深耕在地客戶的深厚經驗，瑞聯銀行亞洲區行政總裁Michael Blake表示，雙方合作建基於共同企業願景、以客為本及高度互補的優勢之上，台新銀行精準掌握臺灣市場高資產客戶需求，瑞聯銀行則具備全球投資視野與國際財富管理經驗；未來瑞聯銀行將分享全球市場洞察、資產配置與投資專業，並透過人才培育與專業交流，協助台新私人銀行團隊拓展國際視野、深化專業能力，共同推動臺灣私人銀行服務持續升級。
台新銀行深耕財富管理35年，持續投入高資產客戶服務，逐步建構涵蓋專業團隊、產品平台，以及臺灣、香港、新加坡據點的完整私銀服務體系。此次與瑞聯銀行策略合作最重要的意義，在於將國際經驗轉化為服務客戶的能力。未來台新銀行將結合自身對臺灣市場及高資產客戶需求的精準掌握，借重瑞聯銀行全球市場洞察與專業經驗，持續精進資產配置、產品服務及財富管理能力，提供更完整、更專業且更具國際視野的私人銀行服務。
展望未來，台新私人銀行將持續以臺灣為根基、連結亞洲、接軌全球，以「認真專業、永續傳承」的精神，實踐「我們承諾守護您的託付」的理念，致力成為高資產客戶與家族長期信賴的「資產負債管理夥伴」，陪伴客戶穩健管理財富、創造長期價值，實現跨世代的財富永續與傳承。
paras_en: Taishin Bank is actively responding to the government’s push for an Asian asset‑management hub and continues to deepen its high‑net‑worth wealth‑management market. On the 23rd, it formally launched the “Taishin Private Bank Asia‑Pacific Flagship Branch,” showcasing its commitment to expanding in southern Taiwan and linking to the Asian wealth‑management market. The opening ceremony was hosted by Lin Shang‑kai, Executive Director of Taishin’s Private Banking and High‑End Wealth Management Division, and featured a strategic alliance memorandum of understanding with Union Bancaire Privée (UBP). Leveraging UBP—one of the largest family‑owned private banks in Switzerland—for its expertise in high‑net‑worth wealth management and international investment will further strengthen Taishin Private Bank’s global perspective and service capacity.

Taishin Private Banking’s Executive Director Lin Shang‑kai noted that, as the Taishin‑Shin Kong Financial Holding merger gradually yields scale benefits, the customer base has grown to over 11.0 million accounts. To meet the rapidly expanding demand for high‑end wealth management, Taishin Bank officially established a “Private Banking and High‑End Wealth Management Division” in 2026, assembling a team of wealth‑planning advisors with more than 20 years of financial experience and CFP, AFP certifications, alongside seasoned lawyers and accountants. This bolsters comprehensive wealth‑planning services for high‑net‑worth clients. Facing global tax changes and generational business transitions, Taishin’s family‑office offers five core services—family investment management, wealth succession, tax services, family governance, and lifestyle concierge—to deliver full‑suite advisory support to affluent families.

Seeing the huge resource advantage and deep local customer expertise that will result from the Taishin‑Shin Kong merger, Michael Blake, President of UBP’s Asia region, said the partnership is built on a shared corporate vision, client‑centric focus and highly complementary strengths. Taishin precisely understands the needs of Taiwan’s high‑net‑worth market, while UBP brings global investment insight and international wealth‑management experience. Going forward, UBP will share global market insights, asset‑allocation and investment expertise, and through talent development and professional exchange will help Taishin’s private‑banking team broaden its international outlook and deepen its capabilities, jointly advancing Taiwan’s private‑banking services.

Taishin Bank has been cultivating wealth management for 35 years, continuously investing in services for high‑net‑worth clients and gradually building a complete private‑banking ecosystem that includes professional teams, product platforms, and locations in Taiwan, Hong Kong and Singapore. The strategic cooperation with UBP is most significant for translating international experience into client‑service capability. In the future, Taishin will combine its precise grasp of the Taiwan market and high‑net‑worth client needs with UBP’s global market insight and expertise, continuously refining asset allocation, product offerings and wealth‑management skills to deliver more comprehensive, professional and internationally‑oriented private‑banking services.

Looking ahead, Taishin Private Bank will remain rooted in Taiwan, connect to Asia and link to the world, embodying the spirit of “serious professionalism and sustainable inheritance.” It pledges to “protect your entrusted assets,” aiming to become a trusted “asset‑liability management partner” for high‑net‑worth individuals and families, helping clients manage wealth prudently, create long‑term value, and achieve cross‑generational wealth sustainability and legacy.

items.title: 〈台經院看景氣〉央行鬆綁+AI發展 不動產景氣可望逐步改善
items.title_en: Taiwan Institute of Economic Research: Central Bank Easing and AI Development to Gradually Improve Real Estate Outlook
paras: 台灣經濟研究院今(23)日公布9月營建業營業氣候測驗點為110.42點，月增 2.81點，再度轉為上揚態勢，台經院認為，由於台灣央行鬆綁房市，且AI產業擴張帶動廠辦和商辦等需求，看不動產業景氣可望逐步改善。
台經院指出，受惠於高科技業者加速擴廠計畫、政府公建預算再創新高，以及進入招商流程的公辦都更與捷運聯開案量體擴大，皆有效支撐我國營造廠營運表現，因此，不論是本月或未來半年，營造業景氣仍是相對較明朗且偏樂觀。
而不動產業方面，儘管既有預售建案持續完工交屋，恐將墊高不動產開發商餘屋庫存壓力，但受惠於全球AI基礎設施擴張，帶動廠房、廠辦等工業不動產需求強勁，且企業對辦公室升級需求穩健，支撐新商辦大樓去化與租金表現，加上國內軌道建設及公辦都更案持續釋出，有助增加不動產開發商相關開發案源，預計未來半年我國不動產業景氣略有改善。
台經院也提到，央行9月理監事會議適度鬆綁兩項房市管制措施，有助提升換屋族購屋意願，並略減輕不動產開發商購地和開工壓力。
paras_en: The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research released today (the 23rd) that the September construction industry business climate index stood at 110.42 points, up 2.81 points from the previous month, marking a renewed upward trend. The institute believes that, as the central bank relaxes housing market restrictions and AI industry expansion drives demand for factory offices and commercial office space, the real‑estate sector’s outlook is expected to improve gradually.

The institute notes that the sector benefits from high‑tech firms accelerating plant expansion, government public‑construction budgets reaching new highs, and the growing volume of public‑sector urban renewal and joint metro‑development projects entering the investment‑attraction stage. These factors effectively support the performance of construction firms, so the construction industry outlook remains relatively clear and optimistic for this month and the next six months.

Regarding real estate, although existing pre‑sale projects continue to be completed and handed over, potentially increasing developers’ unsold inventory, global AI infrastructure expansion is boosting demand for industrial properties such as factories and factory offices. At the same time, corporate demand for office upgrades remains steady, supporting the absorption and rental performance of new commercial office buildings. In addition, ongoing domestic rail projects and public‑sector urban renewal releases will provide more development opportunities for real‑estate developers. Consequently, the institute expects a modest improvement in Taiwan’s real‑estate sector over the next half‑year.

The institute also mentioned that the central bank’s September board meeting moderately eased two housing‑market regulations, which should raise home‑switching buyers’ purchase intent and slightly reduce developers’ pressure in land acquisition and project commencement.

items.title: 〈台經院看景氣〉9月製造業營業氣候續創4年高 惟對未來半年趨保守
items.title_en: Taiwan Institute of Economic Research Sees Business Climate in Manufacturing Hit 4-Year High in September, Yet Outlook for Next Six Months Becomes More Cautious
paras: 台灣經濟研究院今(23)日公布9月營業氣候測驗點，其中，製造業和營建業營業氣候測驗點均上揚，服務業則連續第三個月下滑；其中，製造業測驗點雖續創高，但僅小幅回升，台經院解讀，廠商對景氣的看法與上月大致持平。
9月製造業營業氣候測驗點為101.39點，月增0.50點，創2022年以來高，服務業為92.65點，月減3.15點，為連3減，則創今年以來低。
台經院調查，製造業廠商認為當(9)月景氣為「好」的比率為26.8%，月增 7.3個百分點，認為當月景氣為「壞」的比率則為20.3%，月減5.3個百分點；而對未來半年，看好廠商比率月減3.1個百分點至24.0%，看壞比率增加1.8個百分點至19.8%。
台經院指出，中東衝突持續未解，加上記憶體晶片成本飆升恐抑制消費性電子產品需求，使廠商對未來半年景氣看法較上月調查更趨保守。
服務業方面，近期金融市場波動及外部不確定性仍高，使整體服務業景氣展望偏向審慎。
台經院進一步說明，零售業隨國內大型連鎖百貨陸續進入週年慶促銷旺季，加上電商購物節折扣優惠及普發現金政策效益挹注，可望刺激民眾消費意願，帶動零售市場買氣；銀行業方面，受惠於AI、半導體等科技產業投資動能延續，有助支撐企業放款業務，此外，預期國內利率維持穩定，加上房市信用管制措施適度調整，可望支撐銀行利差和房貸業務表現。
paras_en: The Taiwan Institute of Economic Research released its September business climate index today (the 23rd). Both the manufacturing and construction sectors saw their indices rise, while the services sector declined for the third consecutive month. Although the manufacturing index continued to hit a new high, the increase was modest, and the institute interprets that firms' view of the economy remained roughly unchanged from the previous month.

The September manufacturing business climate index was 101.39 points, up 0.50 points month‑on‑month, the highest since 2022. The services index stood at 92.65 points, down 3.15 points, marking the third consecutive monthly decline and the lowest level this year.

The institute’s survey found that 26.8% of manufacturing firms rated the current (September) economic conditions as "good," up 7.3 percentage points from the prior month, while 20.3% judged conditions as "bad," down 5.3 percentage points. Looking ahead six months, the share of firms optimistic about the outlook fell 3.1 percentage points to 24.0%, and the share pessimistic rose 1.8 percentage points to 19.8%.

The institute noted that the ongoing unresolved Middle‑East conflict, combined with soaring memory‑chip costs that could suppress demand for consumer electronics, has made firms more cautious about the economy over the next six months compared with the previous survey.
For the services sector, recent volatility in financial markets and high external uncertainty continue to push the overall outlook toward a more prudent stance.

The institute added that retail is likely to benefit from the annual‑sale season of major domestic department‑store chains, as well as e‑commerce festival discounts and cash‑back policies, which should boost consumer spending and retail demand. In banking, continued investment momentum in AI, semiconductors and other tech industries supports corporate lending, while stable domestic interest rates and modest adjustments to housing‑credit controls are expected to sustain bank net‑interest margins and mortgage‑loan performance.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉俄烏可望重啟停火和談 台泥挾戰後重建題材股價創逾17個月新高
items.title_en: Hot Stock: Russia-Ukraine Expected to Resume Ceasefire Talks, Taiwan Cement Rides Post-war Reconstruction Theme to Over 17-Month High
paras: 俄烏可望重啟停火談判、戰後重建商機再度引發關注，台泥(1101-TW)可望成為最大受惠者，周四無懼大盤震盪下挫，逆勢走揚，最高來到28.2元，創逾17個月波段高點，收盤來到27.95元，上漲4.29%。
綜合外電報導，俄方表態願意重啟美俄烏三方談判，烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基也表示，支持盡早展開談判；美國總統川普再度宣稱，這可能是結束戰爭最接近的一次。
俄烏戰爭停火再現曙光，市場也看好烏克蘭重建商機；台泥於9月23日宣布擬以不超過7.5億歐元，收購烏克蘭水泥建材公司Ivano-Frankivskcement（IFCEM）等公司100%股權，若俄烏和談順利，台泥可望成為最大受惠者。
根據烏克蘭政府、世界銀行、歐盟與聯合國今年2月發布第五次「快速損害與需求評估」（RDNA5），估算烏克蘭未來10年的重建與復原需求約5880億美元。
此外，根據烏克蘭水泥協會資料，當地水泥消費量在戰前2021年約1060萬噸，2022年戰爭爆發後降至約450萬噸，近年已逐步回穩至每年約620萬至650萬噸，雖尚未恢復至戰前水準，但後續重建仍具市場成長空間。
paras_en: Russia-Ukraine may resume ceasefire negotiations, post-war reconstruction business opportunities again attract attention, Taiwan Cement (1101-TW) is expected to be the biggest beneficiary. On Thursday, despite the market's volatility, the stock rose against the trend, reaching a high of NT$28.2, a more than 17‑month swing high, and closed at NT$27.95, up 4.29%.

According to foreign media reports, Russia has indicated willingness to restart the three‑party talks with the United States and Ukraine, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky also said he supports starting negotiations as soon as possible; U.S. President Donald Trump again claimed this could be the closest chance to end the war.

With a new glimmer of ceasefire in the Russia‑Ukraine war, the market is also optimistic about Ukraine's reconstruction opportunities; Taiwan Cement announced on September 23 that it plans to acquire 100% of the shares of Ukrainian cement and building materials company Ivano‑Frankivsk Cement (IFCEM) and others for up to €750 million. If the Russia‑Ukraine peace talks succeed, Taiwan Cement could be the biggest beneficiary.

Based on the fifth 'Rapid Damage and Needs Assessment' (RDNA5) released in February this year by the Ukrainian government, the World Bank, the EU and the United Nations, the estimated reconstruction and recovery needs for Ukraine over the next ten years amount to about US$588 billion.

In addition, data from the Ukrainian Cement Association show that local cement consumption was about 10.6 million tonnes in 2021 before the war, fell to roughly 4.5 million tonnes after the war broke out in 2022, and has gradually stabilized in recent years at around 6.2‑6.5 million tonnes per year. Although it has not yet returned to pre‑war levels, the subsequent reconstruction still offers market growth potential.

items.title: Jay Goldberg：「英特爾+馬斯克」組合對台積電構成的威脅  可能大於Terafab單打獨鬥
items.title_en: Jay Goldberg: The "Intel + Musk" Combination Poses a Greater Threat to TSMC Than Musk's Solo Terafab
paras: Seaport Research Partners資深半導體分析師Jay Goldberg最新指出，馬斯克對台積電造成威脅之處，不一定是他自己硬要造先進晶片，而是「英特爾進場幫馬斯克蓋Terafab」，這會把單挑馬斯克，變成對抗「英特爾＋馬斯克」。
這位半導體節目《The Circuit》共同主持人接受《Benzinga》 專訪時說：「我如果是台積電，我不會擔心得跟 Elon 打一架，我擔心的是得擋住英特爾加馬斯克，因為光是英特爾就讓我夠擔心了。」
Goldberg 認為，英特爾的製造實力能讓馬斯克的Terafab更快具備競爭力；但英特爾在Terafab裡到底扮演什麼角色，目前仍不清楚。
今年4月，馬斯克曾稱Terafab規劃採用英特爾下一代14A製程。Goldberg還說，英特爾「人才底子非常厚」，若由執行長陳立武（主導製造端，專案速度有機會加快。
但問題在於馬斯克願不願意讓出主控權，Goldberg點出馬斯克堅持IP要握在自己手上，這與英特爾傳統代工邏輯未必相容。
他還說，「台積電與英特爾之間一場非常真實的較量正在拉開」，並坦言一年前他還沒料到會出現這種對抗格局。
被問到Terafab是否會演成「馬斯克對上台積電」的決戰，Goldberg則說：「這個劇本預設了比我目前願意給他的更高成功率」。
今年4月，台積電董事長魏哲家曾回應稱英特爾是強勁對手，但晶圓製造「沒有捷徑」。
英特爾這邊誘因很明確且過去曾說，若拿不到重量級外部客戶，14A技術恐不會推到高產能，最新季報則確認會續推開發。馬斯克的Terafab正好能成為14A關鍵出海口，幫英特爾在重建代工業務時扳回一城。
不過，Goldberg 也提醒英特爾若把命壓在馬斯克長期承諾上是有風險的。「如果我是英特爾，我會擔心一件事，兩年後馬斯克會不會就膩了？」
馬斯克10月初表示，特斯拉與SpaceX會自己建廠與營運，台積電則僅傳出可能承租部分德州廠區，不涉及營運。對此Goldberg 直接吐槽說：「這到底是正經蓋晶圓廠，還是變成英特爾的房地產交易？」
Goldberg先前預估，Terafab 2028年才有機會跑起來，但具商業規模的量產可能拖到2030年。
馬斯克週三(21日)在財報會議上表示，Terafab最終造價可能超過1000億美元，特斯拉、SpaceX 還在分攤出資比例，此前一天他更透露兩家公司已成立特別委員會，評估可能合併。目前，Polymarket 賭盤給出「2027年底前正式宣布合併」約70%機率。
若Terafab真的做成，Goldberg點名最大輸家是台積電，英特爾則如同籃球比賽中的「jump ball(跳球)」，結果可能「非常好」，也可能「非常糟」。他總結道：「可行、野心大、做得到，但主要限制會是資金分配，還有他本人的注意力。」
paras_en: Seaport Research Partners senior semiconductor analyst Jay Goldberg recently pointed out that the threat Musk poses to TSMC isn’t necessarily that he insists on building advanced chips himself, but that "Intel enters to help Musk build Terafab," turning a one‑on‑one fight with Musk into a confrontation with "Intel + Musk."

The co‑host of the semiconductor show "The Circuit" said in a Benzinga interview, "If I were TSMC, I wouldn’t worry about fighting Elon one‑on‑one; I’d worry about having to block Intel plus Elon, because Intel alone already worries me enough."
Goldberg believes Intel’s manufacturing strength could make Musk’s Terafab competitive faster, but it’s still unclear exactly what role Intel would play inside Terafab.

In April this year Musk said Terafab plans to use Intel’s next‑generation 14A process. Goldberg added that Intel "has a very deep talent pool," and if CEO Chen Li‑wu (who leads the manufacturing side) is involved, project speed could improve.
The problem is whether Musk is willing to give up control; Goldberg noted Musk insists on keeping the IP in his own hands, which may not be compatible with Intel’s traditional foundry logic.
He also said, "A very real showdown between TSMC and Intel is unfolding," and admitted that a year ago he didn’t anticipate this kind of competitive landscape.
When asked if Terafab could become the decisive showdown of "Musk versus TSMC," Goldberg replied, "That script assumes a higher success rate than I’m currently willing to give it."
In April this year TSMC chairman Wei Zhe‑jia responded that Intel is a strong rival, but there are "no shortcuts" in wafer manufacturing.

Intel’s incentive is clear; it has previously said that without a heavyweight external customer, 14A may never reach high‑volume production. The latest quarterly report confirmed continued development, and Musk’s Terafab could become the key export outlet for 14A, giving Intel a win as it rebuilds its foundry business.
Goldberg also warned that Intel betting on Musk’s long‑term commitment is risky. "If I were Intel, I’d worry about one thing: will Musk be bored two years from now?"

Musk said in early October that Tesla and SpaceX will build and operate their own factories, while TSMC has only hinted at possibly leasing part of a Texas site, not operating it. Goldberg scoffed, "Is this a serious wafer fab or just an Intel real‑estate deal?"
Goldberg previously estimated Terafab might only get going in 2028, with commercial‑scale mass production possibly delayed until 2030.

Musk told a earnings call on Wednesday (the 21st) that Terafab’s final cost could exceed $100 billion, with Tesla and SpaceX still sharing the investment. The day before, he revealed the two companies had set up a special committee to assess a possible merger. Currently, Polymarket odds give about a 70% chance that a formal merger will be announced by the end of 2027.

If Terafab does materialize, Goldberg named TSMC as the biggest loser, while Intel would be like a "jump ball" in basketball – the outcome could be "very good" or "very bad." He summed up: "Feasible, ambitious, doable, but the main constraints will be capital allocation and his own attention."

items.title: 今年三度上修財測！資料中心不等電網，Bloom Energy營收年增138%，股價卻為何跌兩成？
paras: 2026年10月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 燃料電池廠Bloom Energy(BE-US)10月22日公布第三季營收12.36億美元，年增138.1%，並將2026年全年營收財測上修至44億至46億美元，今年第三度調高展望。以財測中值計算，全年營收將年增約122%；公司表示，第三季表現與第四季客戶交貨時程能見度提高，是這次上修的主要依據。
Bloom以固態氧化物燃料電池，為資料中心、工廠等客戶提供現場供電。大型雲端業者為了更快取得電力，帶動第三季產品營收達10.74億美元，年增179.4%，佔總營收約87%。執行長K. R. Sridhar在法說會表示，在手訂單成長速度仍高於營收，但客戶的資料中心是分階段啟用，設備交付也須配合各場地進度。
出貨放量也帶動規模效益。第三季非GAAP營業利益率由去年同期的8.9%提升至23.1%，營業費用年增約26%，遠低於營收增幅；產品非GAAP毛利率升至38.4%。財務長Simon Edwards指出，產品價格維持強勁、降本持續見效，但新產線啟動與加急交貨仍有額外成本。公司維持全年非GAAP毛利率約34%的預估，並將非GAAP營業利益財測上修至9.6億至10.3億美元。
營收成長尚未同步轉成現金流。第三季營業活動現金淨流出約2715萬美元，資本支出約1.53億美元，主要用於Fremont與Newark既有廠區的設備與產能。公司說明，產品控制權移轉給客戶時即認列營收，但請款依合約里程碑進行，兩者可能落在不同季度；存貨、合約資產與應收帳款增加，也佔用營運資金。
全年營收落在財測區間的哪個位置，仍取決於年底少數交貨案的時點。Bloom依客戶場地的就緒程度，評估在手訂單轉為營收的時間，並依需求逐步擴充產能；管理層表示，正為超過5GW的年產能需求預作準備，但未公布達成時程。

優分析觀點
Bloom的股價在財報公布前就已承壓：公布當天盤中重挫約10%，財報出爐後盤後再跌約4.5%，近一個月累計跌幅逾21%。表面原因有兩個：一是本益比高達約314倍，獲利了結賣壓沉重；二是同一天Meta與晶片股引發AI資本支出疑慮，拖累整個電力族群。
但更關鍵的問題在現金流。Bloom營收大增，現金卻沒有跟著進來，而要擴產到5GW，需要大筆資金。
從優分析資料庫拉長十年來看，Bloom的營業現金流多數季度都是淨流出，近兩年雖然出現大額流入，但集中在少數季度。今年第三季營收年增138%，營業現金流仍淨流出約2715萬美元。原因在於收入與收款的時間差：設備交給客戶時就認列營收，款項卻要依合約里程碑分批收取。
擴產卻等不了收款。Bloom第三季資本支出約1.53億美元，還在為逾5GW的年產能需求預作準備。如果收現速度追不上擴產速度，公司就得靠發行新股或可轉債補足資金。股本一旦增加，即使總獲利持續成長，每股盈餘也會被稀釋，這才是高成長背後真正的代價。

items.title: AI股拋售潮還要跌多久？摩根大通：避險基金多頭部位已大致出清
items.title_en: How Long Will the AI Stock Sell‑off Last? JPMorgan: Hedge‑fund Long Positions Mostly Closed
paras: 《Investing.com》週四 (22 日) 報導，摩根大通指出，隨著投資人自 9 月中旬以來大幅調整股票部位，AI 相關股票的賣壓可能逐漸接近極限。儘管短期逆風仍在，持倉降溫可望開始限制股價進一步下跌的空間。
摩根大通策略師 Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou 在最新報告中表示，該行整體股票持倉指標已明顯低於近期高峰，顯示市場先前偏高的曝險已有所消化。不過，這項判斷主要反映部位調整的進展，並不代表短期波動已經結束。
針對近期引發市場疑慮的新型雲端業者 (neoclouds) 融資問題，摩根大通認為，即使這類業者的融資模式難以持續，也不至於讓整體 AI 資本支出週期脫軌，因為它們在 AI 生態系中的占比仍小，並非不可取代。
根據該行估算，全球上市科技公司今年現金流約為 2.2 兆美元，資本支出約為 1.8 兆美元，其中新型雲端業者分別占約 300 億美元及 800 億美元。
Panigirtzoglou 表示，這意味著，新型雲端業者推動的 AI 基礎設施建置，可由資產負債表更健全、營收來源更多元的科技公司承接，包括大型雲端服務供應商。
從整體資金狀況來看，科技業今年現金流高於資本支出約 4,000 億美元，仍保有融資餘裕。摩根大通指出，科技公司發債，主要是為了在擴大資本支出的同時，維持股票回購。
若融資疑慮進一步蔓延，企業仍可透過延後回購，或增加產業內部的循環融資安排，支應投資需求。Panigirtzoglou 認為，科技業整體現金流足以支應資本支出，代表產業內部仍有資金後盾。
不過，半導體類股仍是潛在波動來源。
摩根大通指出，半導體目前約占全球股市整體風險資本的 1/5，當波動升高時，容易面臨投資人為控制風險而減碼的壓力。
該行研判，避險基金及商品交易顧問 (CTA) 等動能型投資人，可能已大致平倉先前偏高的半導體多頭部位。隨著這波調整逐步完成，相關賣壓可望減輕。
paras_en: Investing.com reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that JPMorgan said the selling pressure on AI‑related stocks may be nearing its limit as investors have dramatically trimmed equity positions since mid‑September. Although short‑term headwinds remain, the cooling of holdings should begin to curb further price declines.

JPMorgan strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou said in a latest note that the firm’s overall equity‑position indicator is now clearly below its recent peak, indicating that the market’s previously elevated exposure has been partially digested. However, this assessment mainly reflects the progress of position adjustments and does not mean short‑term volatility has ended.

Regarding the financing issues of new‑type cloud providers (neoclouds) that have recently raised market concerns, JPMorgan believes that even if these providers’ financing models prove unsustainable, they will not derail the overall AI capital‑expenditure cycle because their share of the AI ecosystem remains small and they are not indispensable.

The bank estimates that global listed technology companies have cash flow of about $2.2 trillion this year and capital expenditures of roughly $1.8 trillion, with new‑type cloud providers accounting for about $30 billion and $80 billion respectively.

Panigirtzoglou noted that this means AI infrastructure projects driven by new‑type cloud providers can be taken over by technology firms with stronger balance sheets and more diversified revenue streams, including large cloud service providers.

Looking at the overall funding picture, the tech sector’s cash flow this year exceeds capital spending by roughly $400 billion, leaving ample financing headroom. JPMorgan said tech companies issue debt mainly to maintain share buybacks while expanding capex.

If financing concerns spread further, companies can still defer buybacks or increase internal circular financing arrangements to meet investment needs. Panigirtzoglou believes the sector’s cash flow is sufficient to cover capex, indicating that internal funding support remains robust.
However, semiconductor stocks remain a potential source of volatility.
JPMorgan pointed out that semiconductors now represent about one‑fifth of total risk capital in global equity markets, and when volatility rises, investors tend to cut exposure to manage risk.

The bank assesses that momentum investors such as hedge funds and commodity‑trading advisors (CTAs) have likely largely closed out their previously oversized long positions in semiconductors. As this adjustment winds down, related selling pressure should ease.

items.title: iPhone Duo等貨排到明年1月 黃牛卻先降價、256GB還遭拒收
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo正式開賣，交貨時間已排至明年1月下旬，黃牛加價行情卻率先降溫。
iPhone Duo推出256GB、512GB、1TB及2TB四種容量，中國售價分別為15999元(人民幣，下同)、17999元、21499元及26499元，成為蘋果歷來最昂貴的手機。
據《財聯社》走訪上海、廣州蘋果直營店，首賣當天二手回收溢價開高走低，最熱門的1TB版本加價幅度從早間人民幣2200元縮至1600至1800元，部分黃牛更直接拒收256GB版本，反映市場對後續供應的預期正在改變。
儘管僅支援eSIM，且未搭載Face ID與長焦鏡頭，新機仍掀起搶購熱潮。10月16日晚間8時開放預購後迅速售罄，蘋果官網一度無法進入。預售期間，二手平台多個版本成交價突破2萬元，1TB黑色版本溢價一度達7143元。
正式開賣前，蘋果已在全球實施限購，中國官網規定每位顧客最多購買兩支，壓縮大量囤貨空間。
首賣當天，上海靜安店外有不少消費者排隊取貨，店員表示，排隊者均已付款、搶到首批供貨，當天才下單的顧客，預計要等到明年1月23日左右。廣州天環廣場門市同樣沒有現貨，官方預訂交貨時間已排至2027年1月下旬。
1TB最搶手 入門與頂規版行情分化
官方通路供貨吃緊，卻未讓黃牛加價幅度持續攀升。上海、廣州兩地首賣當天的回收行情相近，且不同容量版本明顯分化。
上海市場上午9時50分左右，各版本普遍仍可加價1000元以上回收，最高不到2000元；到10時30分左右，部分版本溢價已經回落，1TB約可加價1500至1800元，512GB約加價1200元。
256GB版本則出現拒收情況。有黃牛表示，目前只收1TB版本，也有人願意加價800元收購白色256GB機型。
廣州同樣以1TB最受歡迎，早間回收加價一度達2200元，上午10時30分左右降至1600至1800元。512GB白色版本次之，約加價1100至1400元；256GB普遍加價900元。至於售價最高的2TB版本，有黃牛暫不報價，也有人僅願加價數百元收購。
多名黃牛對後市態度謹慎，認為隨著首批手機陸續提貨、流入市場，可交易貨源增加，下午加價幅度可能進一步縮小。
供應預期改善 產能瓶頸仍未解
Counterpoint Research副總監Liz Lee表示，初期高溢價主要來自上市供應緊張與黃牛炒作，近期溢價回落，則反映市場對供應情況的預期改善。
不過，加價降溫並不代表供應瓶頸已經解除。蘋果原為首款摺疊手機設定1000萬支備貨目標，但受到產線協作及產能提升進度影響，市場機構對年底出貨量仍有明顯分歧。
摩根大通最新研究預估，受限於鉸鏈、超薄玻璃等零組件產能，iPhone Duo今年出貨量約800萬至900萬支，低於先前1000萬支的預期目標。
蘋果也持續強化供應鏈，10月20日宣布與多家美國企業建立或擴大合作。其中，Perryman Company將為包括iPhone Duo在內的蘋果產品供應鈦金屬，蘋果將在三年內提供最高1億美元資金支持。
蘋果加入戰局 能否帶動市場擴大
Liz Lee指出，iPhone Duo的差異化設計，包括奈米紋理內螢幕、旨在減輕摺痕的客製玻璃與膠層結構，以及鈦金屬機身和精密鉸鏈。不過，這些主要是工程改良，並非重大技術突破，蘋果更大的優勢在於品牌、生態系整合及軟體體驗。
她認為，蘋果龐大的既有iPhone用戶群，有助將摺疊手機帶向更廣泛的高階消費者。Counterpoint預估，蘋果加入將推動全球摺疊手機出貨量今年成長24%，2027年再增37%；蘋果在這兩年的全球摺疊手機市占率，預估分別約為25%與40%。
市場擴大也可望讓鉸鏈、超薄玻璃加工及精密結構件供應商受惠，但實際受益程度仍取決於供應鏈布局與供貨比重。
然而，螢幕摺痕、長期耐用性、維修與製造成本，仍是摺疊手機必須克服的問題。
Liz Lee認為，下一階段重點已不是證明技術可行，而是透過軟體優化與日常使用體驗，讓消費者真正感受到大螢幕的價值，願意為較高售價買單。

items.title: 美國多家銀行發現客戶帳戶有未經授權AI代理
items.title_en: Multiple US Banks Find Unauthorized AI Agents in Customer Accounts
paras: 據《Axios》報導，美國多家大型銀行發現，未經銀行核准的第三方人工智慧 (AI) 代理正進入客戶帳戶，部分活動甚至疑似超出使用者指示範圍。由於難以辨識操作是否獲得客戶授權，銀行正加強封鎖相關工具，並加速修改服務條款，防範客戶資金與帳戶安全受到影響。
知情人士指出，這類情況通常是使用者主動提供登入帳號、密碼，允許 AI 助理代為存取帳戶。然而，即使取得客戶同意，仍可能違反多數銀行要求客戶本人登入帳戶的規範。
換言之，「使用者授權」並不等於「銀行核准」。
銀行主管擔心，一旦 AI 代理取得登入權限，尤其使用者又授予購物或資金移轉權限，系統後續採取的行動可能直接影響客戶財務。知情人士透露，部分銀行也追蹤到 AI 代理聯繫客服中心，或疑似在未依循使用者指示的情況下採取行動。
不過，報導並未公布具體個案、受影響帳戶數量，也未交代是否已造成實際財務損失。
面對風險，摩根士丹利 (MS-US)、摩根大通 (JPM-US)、美國銀行 (BAC-US)、富國銀行 (WFC-US) 等大型金融機構正加緊因應。
知情人士表示，摩根士丹利已開始阻擋第三方 AI 代理存取旗下平台；摩根大通、美國銀行與花旗 (C-US) 也正限制相關工具的使用。
對此，摩根大通旗下大通銀行發言人提醒，客戶不應將使用者名稱及密碼提供給任何人。
摩根士丹利發言人則表示，該行未觀察到「失控 AI 代理存取旗下平台」的情況。
銀行面臨的核心難題，是難以確認帳戶背後的操作究竟來自真人，還是 AI 代理；若是代理，也不容易判斷其行動是否符合使用者授權。
一名銀行主管告訴《Axios》，銀行不僅難以區分不同代理，也難以辨識代理是經客戶同意進入帳戶，還是已失控並取得存取權限。
目前，多數銀行已允許，或正朝允許第三方工具取得「唯讀」權限的方向發展。這類權限讓工具能查看客戶財務資訊，但無法執行交易或移轉資金，類似銀行提供給 Quicken 等記帳與預算管理應用程式的存取方式。
多名銀行與產業主管坦言，客戶未來仍會希望使用 AI 代理處理金融事務，因此業者需要在便利性與安全之間取得平衡。不過，在授權辨識與風險控管機制尚未成熟之前，過度開放的風險仍然太高。
知情人士指出，銀行除了投資防禦措施，也開始規劃事故發生後的應變情境，包括如何迅速保護帳戶、恢復客戶存取權限。儘管大型銀行具備資金與關鍵基礎設施管理經驗，AI 技術快速演進、持續暴露新弱點，仍讓金融業面臨新的資安挑戰。
paras_en: According to Axios, several large U.S. banks have discovered that third‑party artificial‑intelligence (AI) agents, not approved by the banks, are accessing customer accounts, with some activities apparently exceeding the users’ instructions. Because it is difficult to determine whether the actions are authorized by the customer, banks are tightening blocks on such tools and speeding up revisions to their terms of service to protect customer funds and account security.

Insiders say these situations typically arise when users voluntarily provide their login IDs and passwords, allowing an AI assistant to access the account on their behalf. Even with the customer’s consent, this may still violate most banks’ rules that require the account holder to log in personally.
In other words, “user authorization” does not equal “bank approval.”

Bank executives worry that once an AI agent gains login rights—especially if the user also grants shopping or fund‑transfer permissions—the system’s subsequent actions could directly affect the customer’s finances. Insiders note that some banks have also observed AI agents contacting customer‑service centers or seemingly acting without following the user’s directions.
However, the report did not disclose specific cases, the number of affected accounts, or whether any actual financial loss has occurred.
Facing the risk, major financial institutions such as Morgan Stanley (MS‑US), JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US), Bank of America (BAC‑US) and Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) are stepping up their responses.
Sources say Morgan Stanley has begun blocking third‑party AI agents from accessing its platform; JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America and Citi (C‑US) are also restricting the use of related tools.
In response, a spokesperson for JPMorgan Chase’s Chase Bank reminded customers not to share their usernames and passwords with anyone.
A Morgan Stanley spokesperson said the firm has not observed any “runaway AI agents accessing its platform.”

The core challenge for banks is the difficulty of confirming whether actions behind an account are performed by a real person or an AI agent; even if it is an agent, it is hard to judge whether its actions align with the user’s authorization.

A bank executive told Axios that banks not only struggle to differentiate among various agents but also to determine whether the agent entered the account with the customer’s consent or has gone rogue and obtained access rights.

Currently, most banks have allowed—or are moving toward allowing—third‑party tools only “read‑only” access. This permission lets tools view a customer’s financial information but not execute trades or transfer funds, similar to the access banks grant to budgeting apps like Quicken.

Several bank and industry leaders admit that customers will continue to want AI agents to handle financial tasks, so firms need to balance convenience with security. However, until authentication and risk‑control mechanisms mature, the risk of overly open access remains too high.

Insiders note that banks are not only investing in defensive measures but also planning post‑incident response scenarios, including how to quickly protect accounts and restore customer access. Even though large banks have experience managing capital and critical infrastructure, the rapid evolution of AI technology and the continual emergence of new vulnerabilities still pose fresh cybersecurity challenges for the financial sector.

items.title: SpaceX Q3財報首度轉虧為盈：三大業務協同下的成長與隱憂
items.title_en: SpaceX Q3 Earnings Turn Profit for the First Time: Growth and Risks Under Three Business Synergies
paras: 航太科技公司 SpaceX 於德州巴斯特羅普的星鏈衛星工廠召開 2026 年第三季業績說明會。這是公司於今年 6 月正式上市後的第二份季度財報，各項財務數據均大幅超越市場預期：單季營收達 146 億美元，較上年同期大幅成長 161%；季度淨利錄得 44 億美元，成功扭轉上年同期淨虧損 11 億美元的局面，為公司上市後首次實現季度獲利，推動市值逼近 2 兆美元。
本次財報揭示 SpaceX 正經歷關鍵的業務型態轉變，從傳統火箭發射商加速轉型為整合 AI 運算基礎設施與全球網路連線的科技巨頭。

業務結構翻轉

從業務營收結構觀察，超級智能(SI)算力部門第三季營收達 75.6 億美元，年增 830%，占整體營收比重達 52%，僅歷時一個季度便超越星鏈，躍居公司第一大收入來源。星鏈所在的網路連線業務營收為 52.5 億美元，年增 69%，占營收比重約 36%；傳統核心的航太發射業務營收則為 17.7 億美元，年增 6%，營收占比降至 12%。
《礪石商業評論》報導，若深入檢視營業利益結構，星鏈業務第三季營業利益達 23.67 億美元(年增 99%)，毛利率達 55%，仍是支撐整家公司現金流的獲利支柱。相較之下，SI 算力業務營業利益為 4.31 億美元(若剔除收購 Cursor 產生的 12 億美元股權激勵開支則約為 16 億美元)；航太發射部門因承擔高額基礎研發，單季則錄得 700 萬美元的營業虧損。

三大成長曲線：發射、連線與電力基建的協同效應

《礪石商業評論》分析，SpaceX 的三大業務並非各自獨立，而是形成緊密的協同閉環。航太發射業務雖短期虧損，卻是降低軌道運載成本與大規模部署星鏈 V3 衛星的物理前提；執行長馬斯克表示，星艦(Starship)第 14 次飛行已成功將星鏈 V3 衛星送入軌道，並規劃明年上半年達到每週一次發射、下半年提升至每週兩次。
星鏈連線方面，全球寬頻消費訂閱用戶已達 1,360 萬戶，企業與航空業務成長顯著，目前已簽約約 1.2 萬架客機，具備極高的用戶黏著度與穩定的現金流挹注。
在 AI 算力基礎設施方面，SpaceX 截至第三季底的額定算力達 1.7 GW，預計年底前將擴展至 2.5 至 3 GW。馬斯克強調，目前布建超級智能的瓶頸在於電力與散熱冷卻設施，而非晶片本身。
其中，SpaceX 將火箭引擎的高階金屬鑄造工藝轉移至地面發電渦輪葉片製造，使電力設施上線時間較同業縮短 12 至 18 個月，成為支撐其算力快速擴張的核心工程優勢。

高資本支出與估值假設的潛在風險

儘管成長動能強勁，報告中仍有數項財務與營運風險：
資本支出負擔沉重：SpaceX 第三季資本支出達 195.93 億美元(超過當期營收)，第四季預估更將達 350 億至 400 億美元，財務結構面臨實質槓桿壓力，一旦租賃價格下行將加劇營運負擔。
算力回收週期假設嚴苛：目前宣稱算力投資可於一年內回收，是建立在每瓦 30 至 50 美元高租金的週期性假設之上，若市場供給過剩，租金定價恐迅速面臨修正。
長期指引與時間表需審慎看待：馬斯克提出 2027 年底年度經常性收入(ARR)達 5,000 億至 1 兆美元的展望，作者引述財務長當時「猝不及防」的現場反應，指出該目標屬於高層直覺預估而非嚴謹財務模型，相對而言，財務長給出的 2027 年第一季營收指引(330 億至 370 億美元)較具口徑支持。
此外，與特斯拉的潛在合併仍處於獨立董事委員會評估階段，需全體股東過半數支持，執行門檻高且具不確定性。
paras_en: Space aerospace technology company SpaceX held its 2026 third‑quarter earnings briefing at the Starlink satellite factory in Boca Chica, Texas. This is the second quarterly report since the company went public in June, and all financial metrics far exceeded market expectations: quarterly revenue reached $14.6 billion, up 161% year‑over‑year; quarterly net profit was $4.4 billion, reversing a $1.1 billion loss in the same quarter last year and marking the company’s first quarterly profit since listing, pushing its market value toward $2 trillion.

The report reveals that SpaceX is undergoing a pivotal business model shift, accelerating its transformation from a traditional rocket launch provider into a technology giant that integrates AI computing infrastructure with a global network connection.

Business Structure Flip
From a revenue‑share perspective, the Super‑Intelligent (SI) computing division posted $7.56 billion in Q3 revenue, an 830% year‑over‑year increase, accounting for 52% of total revenue and overtaking Starlink as the top revenue source in just one quarter. Starlink’s connectivity business generated $5.25 billion, up 69% year‑over‑year and representing about 36% of revenue, while the traditional aerospace launch segment earned $1.77 billion, up 6% year‑over‑year, with its share falling to 12%.

According to Lithic Business Review, a deeper look at operating profit shows Starlink’s Q3 operating profit at $2.367 billion (up 99% YoY) with a 55% gross margin, remaining the cash‑flow backbone of the company. By contrast, the SI computing unit’s operating profit was $431 million (or roughly $1.6 billion after excluding $1.2 billion of equity‑incentive expense tied to the Cursor acquisition); the aerospace launch division recorded a $7 million operating loss for the quarter due to heavy R&D spending.

Three Growth Curves: Synergies Among Launch, Connectivity and Power Infrastructure
Lithic Business Review notes that SpaceX’s three businesses are not independent but form a tight synergistic loop. The launch segment, though loss‑making in the short term, is the physical prerequisite for lowering orbital transport costs and mass‑deploying Starlink V3 satellites. CEO Elon Musk said the 14th Starship flight successfully placed V3 satellites into orbit and plans to achieve one launch per week in the first half of next year, increasing to two per week in the second half.

On the Starlink side, global broadband subscriber households have reached 13.6 million, with enterprise and aviation customers growing markedly; the company has signed contracts for roughly 12,000 aircraft, providing high user stickiness and stable cash‑flow inflows.

Regarding AI computing infrastructure, SpaceX’s rated compute capacity stood at 1.7 GW at the end of Q3, and it expects to expand to between 2.5 GW and 3 GW by year‑end. Musk emphasized that the current bottleneck for scaling super‑intelligent compute lies in power and cooling infrastructure, not the chips themselves.

SpaceX has transferred its high‑grade metal casting process for rocket engines to the production of ground‑based power turbine blades, shortening the time to bring power facilities online by 12‑18 months versus peers, which underpins its rapid compute expansion advantage.

High Capital Expenditure and Valuation Assumption Risks
Despite strong growth momentum, the report flags several financial and operational risks:

Heavy capital‑expenditure burden: SpaceX’s Q3 capex reached $19.593 billion (exceeding quarterly revenue), and Q4 is projected at $35‑$40 billion, creating real leverage pressure; a decline in lease pricing would further strain operations.

Stringent compute‑recovery cycle assumptions: The claim that compute investments can be recouped within a year rests on a high‑rent scenario of $30‑$50 per kilowatt; oversupply could force rapid rent corrections.

Long‑term guidance and timelines require caution: Musk’s outlook of $500 billion to $1 trillion in annual recurring revenue (ARR) by end‑2027 was met with a “caught off guard” reaction from the CFO, who noted the target is a high‑level intuition rather than a rigorous model, whereas the CFO’s Q1‑2027 revenue guidance of $33‑$37 billion is more substantively supported.

Additionally, a potential merger with Tesla remains under review by an independent board committee and would need approval from a majority of shareholders, making the execution threshold high and uncertain.

items.title: OpenAI傳推進300億美元新融資 估值下調至1.25兆美元 華爾街不再搶購
items.title_en: OpenAI Announces Push for $30 B New Funding Round, Valuation Cut to $1.25 T; Wall Street No Longer Scrambling
paras: 人工智慧龍頭 OpenAI 正接近完成新一輪高達 300 億美元的融資，談判已進入最後階段，目標投前估值定為 1.25 兆美元。此估值並不包含本輪募集的新資金。
儘管 1.25 兆美元相較於今年 3 月完成融資時的 8,520 億美元估值(含新資金)仍大幅增長近 50%，但已較本月早先向投資人提出的 1.4 兆美元報價下調約 1,500 億美元，主因是部分投資人對過高定價產生阻力。
本次估值目標下修，正值美股科技股面臨沈重拋售壓力之際，市場對債務驅動的 AI 基礎設施繁榮能否延續產生高度疑慮，Meta 與特斯拉(TSLA-US)好壞參半的財報亦加劇了投資人的擔憂。
據報導，摩根士丹利與舊金山科技基金 Dragoneer 先前曾以 1.4 兆美元投前估值向財富管理客戶推介 OpenAI，然而市場買氣明顯降溫。參與推介流程的知情人士直言，過程中「完全沒有出現任何搶購」，並感嘆「此前每次 OpenAI 出現時都是狂熱，這次有點沉悶」。
此外，由於 OpenAI 與其主要競爭對手 Anthropic 近期密集大舉募資，部分投資人已出現資金「消化不良」與投資疲勞，甚至寧願等待 Anthropic 預計進行的首次公開募股(IPO)定價出爐後再行定奪。
在資金結構方面，美國投資管理集團 Coatue 與阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)的投資基金正協商共同領投，此輪融資被定位為邁向潛在 IPO 前的「機會主義型」過渡融資。
除資金挹注外，OpenAI 正與阿聯洽談商業協議，爭取對當地合作夥伴開發的新運算資源擁有優先購買權，以支應其預計在 2030 年前累積達 6,000 億美元的總運算支出。
OpenAI 已要求潛在投資人在 10 月底前確定認購意向，最終募資額可能低於 300 億美元；對此，OpenAI 與 Coatue 均拒絕置評或尚未回應。
針對公開上市的時程規劃，OpenAI 雖已於今年 6 月向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)秘密遞交公開說明書，但具體時間仍未拍板，內部高層看法也有所不同。
財務長Sarah Friar 於 8 月向內部員工表示，OpenAI「將在 2027 年成為上市公司」；但執行長Sam Altman 隨後在 9 月公開表態，認為「現在上市將是不明智的時機」，並以專注於 AI 安全發展為由推遲掛牌規劃。
paras_en: AI leader OpenAI is close to completing a new financing round of up to $30 billion, with negotiations in the final stage and a pre‑money valuation set at $1.25 trillion. This valuation does not include the new capital raised in this round.

Although the $1.25 trillion figure represents a nearly 50% increase over the $852 billion valuation (including new money) achieved in March, it is about $150 billion lower than the $1.4 trillion price tag presented to investors earlier this month, mainly because some investors balked at what they saw as an overly high price.

The downward revision comes as U.S. tech stocks are under heavy selling pressure and the market doubts whether the debt‑driven AI infrastructure boom can be sustained; mixed earnings from Meta and Tesla (TSLA‑US) have also heightened investor concerns.

According to reports, Morgan Stanley and San Francisco‑based Dragoneer had previously pitched OpenAI to wealth‑management clients at a $1.4 trillion pre‑money valuation, but market appetite has clearly cooled. Insiders involved in the pitch said there was "absolutely no buying frenzy" and lamented that "every previous OpenAI launch was a frenzy, this time it feels dull."

Moreover, with OpenAI and its main rival Anthropic both raising large sums recently, some investors are experiencing "capital indigestion" and fatigue, preferring to wait for Anthropic’s anticipated IPO pricing before making a decision.

On the capital structure side, U.S. investment firm Coatue and a United Arab Emirates (UAE) sovereign fund are negotiating to co‑lead the round, which is being framed as an opportunistic bridge financing ahead of a potential IPO.

Beyond the cash infusion, OpenAI is negotiating a commercial agreement with the UAE to secure priority purchase rights on new compute resources developed by local partners, supporting its plan to spend $600 billion on compute by 2030.

OpenAI has asked prospective investors to confirm their commitments by the end of October, and the final amount raised could end up below $30 billion; both OpenAI and Coatue declined to comment or have not responded yet.

Regarding the timeline for a public listing, OpenAI secretly filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) in June, but a concrete date has not been set and internal senior executives hold differing views.

CFO Sarah Friar told staff in August that OpenAI "will be a public company by 2027," but CEO Sam Altman later said in September that "going public now would be ill‑timed," pushing back the listing plan to focus on AI safety development.

items.title: 豪砸3500億美元布局AI！南韓SK Hyper洽談融資 劍指15GW資料中心容量
items.title_en: Spending $350 billion to Build AI! South Korea's SK Hyper Negotiates Financing, Aiming for 15GW Data Center Capacity
paras: 南韓SK集團旗下資料中心事業SK Hyper正與大型科技公司及金融投資人洽談，為規模高達3,500億美元的人工智慧(AI)基建計畫募集資金。
SK Hyper於今年7月成立，是SK電信(SK Telecom)旗下事業，目標是以南韓為據點為全球科技公司提供服務，支援其在亞洲各地的AI業務。SK電信計劃在2030年前為SK Hyper投資7,500億韓元。
SK Hyper目標是在2035年前，於南韓興建總容量達15GW的資料中心，而第一階段5GW的建置計畫，單是設備等相關支出就需要3500億美元。
SK Hyper執行長Chung Suk-geun表示，SK Hyper目標是在2026年底或2027年初完成首輪外部募資，並打算在接下來三到四年進行更多輪募資。
投資人再度擔憂未來需求是否足以支撐全球在運算基礎設施上的龐大支出，對此Chung表示，公司打算與資料中心租戶及外部投資人共同分擔建置成本，而且SK Hyper將依據實際需求調整投資規模，而不會一開始就承諾完成整項計畫。
paras_en: South Korea's SK Group subsidiary SK Hyper, which runs a data‑center business, is in talks with large technology firms and financial investors to raise funds for an AI infrastructure program worth up to $350 billion.

SK Hyper was founded in July of this year as a unit of SK Telecom. Its goal is to use South Korea as a hub to serve global tech companies and support their AI operations across Asia. SK Telecom plans to invest 750 billion won in SK Hyper before 2030.
SK Hyper aims to build data‑center capacity of 15 GW in South Korea by 2035, and the first phase of 5 GW alone will require equipment and related spending of $350 billion.

SK Hyper CEO Chung Suk‑geun said the company targets completing its first external fundraising round by the end of 2026 or early 2027, and plans to conduct additional rounds over the next three to four years.

Investors are again worried whether future demand will be enough to justify the massive spending on computing infrastructure worldwide. Chung replied that the company will share construction costs with data‑center tenants and external investors, and that SK Hyper will adjust the scale of investment based on actual demand rather than committing to the full plan up front.

items.title: 蘋果iPhone Duo正式開賣 全球掀排隊潮 大陸黃牛不敢加價太多
items.title_en: Apple iPhone Duo Officially Launches, Sparking Global Queues; Mainland Resellers Hesitant to Mark Up Too Much
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)首款摺疊智慧型手機 iPhone Duo 周五(23日)正式發售，全球多地直營門市重現暌違已久的排隊盛況。這款新機不僅代表著 iPhone 近20年歷史中最激進的設計變革，更是新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)9 月接掌帥印後的首場硬體大考。
新機自 10 月 16 日開放預購後僅數分鐘，首批配額便迅速售罄，官方預估出貨時間已被迫延後至明年 1 月下旬，供不應求的熱烈迴響讓蘋果直言消費者的反應「非同凡響」。

高昂定價難擋果粉熱情

iPhone Duo 起售價高達 2,000 美元，頂規 2TB 版本更上看 3,199 美元，創下主流大眾智慧型手機的天價紀錄。然而，即便定價不菲，全球買氣依然高漲。
澳洲雪梨門市開門前便大排長龍，48 歲的工程師Simon Krishnan花費 3,899 澳元(約新台幣 8.9 萬元)購入 512GB 機型，坦言：「這款手機對我來說是奢侈品，因為實在太貴了，但我覺得人生苦短，買就對了。」
新加坡門市聚集數百名果粉，甚至有來自緬甸的一家七口在門市外通宵搭帳篷守候。來自倫敦的技術長Peter Ingram在店內體驗後讚嘆：「這是蘋果多年來真正的創新，雖然昂貴，但我親自試用後覺得不可思議，螢幕完全沒有摺痕。」
雖然中國大陸與香港限定僅供線上預購者取貨，上海與北京門市依然大排長龍。已擁有小米摺疊手機的 26 歲醫療從業人員Liu Wei清晨 6 點就到上海門市排隊，表示自己使用蘋果產品多年，對品牌更有信任感，因此開賣首日便想搶先嘗試。
北京三里屯門市消費者 Andy Shen 則表示：「這需要時間習慣，我選 Duo 是因為展開後螢幕更大，看影片體驗更好，但其他功能如相機確實不如前幾代。」38 歲的香港買家 May 則透過轉售 256GB 機型賺取約 4,000 港元差價，笑稱是「賺個幾餐飯錢」。

二級市場黃牛直言「怕泡沫大賣不出去」

在中國大陸，伴隨首批取貨人潮，門市周邊也迅速聚集大量黃牛收購，現場回收加價普遍在 2,000 至 3,000 元人民幣之間，甚至有黃牛以加價 4,000 元收購 1TB 頂規機型。
然而，面對高昂的資金成本，部分黃牛坦承轉手風險極高，直言「不敢加太多，怕泡沫大賣不出去」，擔憂加價收來的機器後續未必容易轉售。
二手交易平台數據顯示，預售一週後各容量版本的加價空間均明顯縮小近五成(256GB 與 512GB 溢價幅度縮水約 48% 至 51%)，消費者實際願意承受的溢價普遍降至 2,000 元左右，市場追價動能已見回落。

產能瓶頸與市場前景

供應鏈方面，iPhone Duo 因搭載複雜的先進轉軸與新顯示技術，組裝難度極高，且初期僅由少數中國廠房生產，導致產能供應極度受限，交貨延遲時間創下蘋果近代罕見紀錄。
儘管產品定價高昂且初期使用體驗評價不一，市調機構國際數據資訊(IDC)副總裁Francisco Jeronimo仍看好其帶動效應，認為摺疊手機問世多年普及度有限，蘋果的加入有望吸引更廣大的消費者群體。IDC 更樂觀預測，蘋果將在 2026 年奪下全球摺疊手機市場 44% 銷售額與 31% 出貨量，並於 2027 年躍居營收與出貨量雙料冠軍。
Jeronimo強調，蘋果已成功向外界展現摺疊手機的吸引力，接下來真正的考驗，在於能否將早期的市場熱度轉化為長期穩定的實際銷量。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) released its first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, on Friday (the 23rd). Direct‑sale stores worldwide saw queues return after a long hiatus. The device marks the most radical design shift in the iPhone’s nearly 20‑year history and serves as the first major hardware test for new CEO John Ternus, who took the helm in September.

The phone opened for pre‑orders on October 16 and sold out its initial allocation within minutes. Apple now expects shipments to be delayed until late January next year, and the overwhelming demand has led the company to describe consumer reaction as “extraordinary.”

High price cannot dampen fan enthusiasm. The iPhone Duo starts at $2,000, with the top‑spec 2 TB model priced at $3,199, setting a record for mainstream smartphones. Yet despite the steep pricing, global demand remains strong.

In Sydney, Australia, a long line formed before the store opened. 48‑year‑old engineer Simon Krishnan paid AU$3,899 (about NT$89,000) for the 512 GB model, saying, “This phone is a luxury for me because it’s so expensive, but life is short, so I’m glad I bought it.”

A crowd of hundreds gathered at the Singapore store, and a family of seven from Myanmar camped out overnight in tents outside. After trying the device in London, CTO Peter Ingram praised, “This is Apple’s real innovation after years, expensive as it is, but the screen has no crease at all – it’s incredible.”

Although sales in mainland China and Hong Kong are limited to online pre‑order pickup, stores in Shanghai and Beijing still saw long queues. 26‑year‑old medical worker Liu Wei, who already owns a Xiaomi foldable, arrived at the Shanghai store at 6 a.m., saying his long‑standing use of Apple products gives him greater trust in the brand, so he wanted to be among the first to try it on launch day.

In Beijing’s Sanlitun store, consumer Andy Shen said, “It takes time to get used to, but I chose the Duo because the unfolded screen is larger and video watching is better, even though other features like the camera aren’t as good as previous generations.” 38‑year‑old Hong Kong buyer May resold a 256 GB unit for about HK$4,000 profit, joking it was “just enough for a few meals.”

Secondary‑market scalpers in mainland China said they fear a bubble if they raise prices too much. Around the stores, scalpers quickly gathered to buy devices, typically adding RMB 2,000‑3,000 to the retail price, with some demanding up to RMB 4,000 extra for the 1 TB top‑spec model.
However, facing high capital costs, some scalpers admitted the resale risk is very high, stating, “We can’t mark up too much, afraid the bubble will burst and we won’t be able to sell.”

Data from second‑hand platforms show that a week after pre‑sale, the markup space for all capacities shrank by roughly 48‑51%, with consumers now willing to pay only about RMB 2,000 extra. The market’s price‑pushing momentum has clearly cooled.

Capacity bottlenecks and market outlook: The iPhone Duo’s complex hinge and new display technology make assembly extremely difficult, and early production is limited to a few factories in China, severely restricting supply and creating delivery delays unprecedented in recent Apple history.

Despite the high price and mixed early user reviews, IDC’s vice‑president Francisco Jeronimo remains optimistic about its impact. He notes that foldable phones have had limited adoption, and Apple’s entry could attract a broader consumer base. IDC forecasts Apple will capture 44% of global foldable‑phone revenue and 31% of shipments in 2026, and become the top revenue and shipment leader in 2027.
Jerónimo emphasizes that Apple has successfully demonstrated the appeal of foldable phones, but the real test now is whether early market excitement can be turned into sustained, long‑term sales.

items.title: 今年三度上修財測！資料中心不等電網，Bloom Energy營收年增138%，股價卻為何跌兩成？
paras: 2026年10月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 燃料電池廠Bloom Energy(BE-US)10月22日公布第三季營收12.36億美元，年增138.1%，並將2026年全年營收財測上修至44億至46億美元，今年第三度調高展望。以財測中值計算，全年營收將年增約122%；公司表示，第三季表現與第四季客戶交貨時程能見度提高，是這次上修的主要依據。
Bloom以固態氧化物燃料電池，為資料中心、工廠等客戶提供現場供電。大型雲端業者為了更快取得電力，帶動第三季產品營收達10.74億美元，年增179.4%，佔總營收約87%。執行長K. R. Sridhar在法說會表示，在手訂單成長速度仍高於營收，但客戶的資料中心是分階段啟用，設備交付也須配合各場地進度。
出貨放量也帶動規模效益。第三季非GAAP營業利益率由去年同期的8.9%提升至23.1%，營業費用年增約26%，遠低於營收增幅；產品非GAAP毛利率升至38.4%。財務長Simon Edwards指出，產品價格維持強勁、降本持續見效，但新產線啟動與加急交貨仍有額外成本。公司維持全年非GAAP毛利率約34%的預估，並將非GAAP營業利益財測上修至9.6億至10.3億美元。
營收成長尚未同步轉成現金流。第三季營業活動現金淨流出約2715萬美元，資本支出約1.53億美元，主要用於Fremont與Newark既有廠區的設備與產能。公司說明，產品控制權移轉給客戶時即認列營收，但請款依合約里程碑進行，兩者可能落在不同季度；存貨、合約資產與應收帳款增加，也佔用營運資金。
全年營收落在財測區間的哪個位置，仍取決於年底少數交貨案的時點。Bloom依客戶場地的就緒程度，評估在手訂單轉為營收的時間，並依需求逐步擴充產能；管理層表示，正為超過5GW的年產能需求預作準備，但未公布達成時程。

優分析觀點
Bloom的股價在財報公布前就已承壓：公布當天盤中重挫約10%，財報出爐後盤後再跌約4.5%，近一個月累計跌幅逾21%。表面原因有兩個：一是本益比高達約314倍，獲利了結賣壓沉重；二是同一天Meta與晶片股引發AI資本支出疑慮，拖累整個電力族群。
但更關鍵的問題在現金流。Bloom營收大增，現金卻沒有跟著進來，而要擴產到5GW，需要大筆資金。
從優分析資料庫拉長十年來看，Bloom的營業現金流多數季度都是淨流出，近兩年雖然出現大額流入，但集中在少數季度。今年第三季營收年增138%，營業現金流仍淨流出約2715萬美元。原因在於收入與收款的時間差：設備交給客戶時就認列營收，款項卻要依合約里程碑分批收取。
擴產卻等不了收款。Bloom第三季資本支出約1.53億美元，還在為逾5GW的年產能需求預作準備。如果收現速度追不上擴產速度，公司就得靠發行新股或可轉債補足資金。股本一旦增加，即使總獲利持續成長，每股盈餘也會被稀釋，這才是高成長背後真正的代價。

items.title: 光通訊｜平面光波導（PLC）晶片產能訂滿到2027年中，Enablence營收拚年增150%
items.title_en: Optical Communications | PLC Chip Capacity Booked Through Mid‑2027, Enablence Revenue Set to Grow ~150% YoY
paras: 2026年10月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 光通訊晶片廠Enablence(ENA-CA)10月22日法說會表示，現有產能已被合約訂滿到2027會計年度底（2027年6月），接下來營收成長要看擴產進度。公司維持9月公布的財測，全年營收1,900萬至2,100萬美元，以中值計算，年增約150%（2026會計年度為810萬美元）。
需求來自AI資料中心。Enablence自行設計並製造平面光波導（PLC）晶片，營收主要來自AI通訊基礎建設，並逐步跨入組裝業務。執行長Todd Haugen表示，資料中心需要更高速、更低功耗的光傳輸方案，客戶需求已超過公司的供應能力。
800G、1.6T光收發模組會用多個波長並行傳輸資料。PLC晶片負責把多路光合成一條光纖送出（多工），到了接收端再拆開（解多工），常見產品是AWG陣列波導光柵。傳輸速度越高、通道越多，對PLC的需求就越大。
產能滿載，也讓獲利結構跟著改善。一方面，產量提高可以分攤固定成本；另一方面，公司把晶圓優先分配給毛利較高的新合約，推升每片晶圓的平均售價。公司預估2027會計年度毛利率25%至35%，上一年度則是負16%。
最新財報已經看得到轉折。2026會計年度第四季（截至6月底）營收290萬美元，年增38%；毛利率8%，連續兩季轉正，但單季仍淨損600萬美元。已結束的2027會計年度第一季，公司初估營收約400萬美元，年增近500%，仍待正式季報確認。
風險在於客戶過度集中。前三大客戶約占九成業務，其中最大客戶就占約68%。擴產能否如期，以及能否分散客戶，將決定這波成長能走多遠。

優分析觀點
在PLC技術的光開關（WSS）中，依Mordor Intelligence統計，日本NTT Electronics一家就掌握全球逾七成產能，其餘多為日本與中國業者；西方大廠主力放在LCoS、MEMS等其他技術，加上缺乏專用的二氧化矽PLC製造設施，很少投入PLC。
Enablence在加州自有PLC晶圓廠，加上越南組裝，公司是北美唯一對外接單的PLC晶圓廠，正好吸引想降低地緣政治風險的北美雲端業者與光模組廠。因此，Enablence這次財報所稱的供需缺口並非新訊息，也不太能解讀為整體產業需求上修。
早在2024會計年度，公司就已取得每週逾500片晶圓的需求，當時產能只有每週125片，供給嚴重不夠。現在公司指出訂單排到2027年中，其實並非新訊息，因為這個產業的營收能長多快，取決於產能爬坡速度。
公司於今年6月底每週投片不到400片，目前已拉到約750片，目標2026年底達1,000片、2027年6月達1,200片。
公司表示，每週1,000片可貢獻每月逾250萬美元營收，年化超過3,000萬美元，高於全年財測上緣的2,100萬美元。換句話說，財測反映的是產能爬坡進度，不是需求上限；產能開得越快，營收就越有機會超越財測。
