paras_en: On October 22, Enablence (ENA-CA) held an earnings call stating that its existing capacity is fully booked through the end of fiscal 2027 (June 2027). Future revenue growth will depend on the pace of capacity expansion. The company maintains its September outlook of full‑year revenue between $19 million and $21 million, which at the midpoint implies roughly a 150% year‑over‑year increase from $8.1 million in fiscal 2026.

Demand comes from AI data centers. Enablence designs and manufactures planar lightwave circuit (PLC) chips, with revenue primarily derived from AI communications infrastructure and gradually expanding into assembly services. CEO Todd Haugen said data centers need faster, lower‑power optical transmission solutions, and customer demand has already outstripped the company’s supply capability.

800‑Gbps and 1.6‑Tbps optical transceiver modules use multiple wavelengths to transmit data in parallel. PLC chips combine many optical channels onto a single fiber for transmission (multiplexing) and then separate them again at the receiver (demultiplexing). A common product is the AWG (arrayed waveguide grating). Higher speeds and more channels drive greater demand for PLCs.

Full capacity utilization also improves the profit structure. Higher volumes spread fixed costs, and the company prioritizes wafer allocation to higher‑margin new contracts, raising the average wafer selling price. Enablence estimates a gross margin of 25%‑35% for fiscal 2027, versus a negative 16% in the prior year.

The latest financials already show a turning point. In Q4 of fiscal 2026 (through June), revenue was $2.9 million, up 38% year‑over‑year, with an 8% gross margin and two consecutive quarters of positive gross profit, though the quarter still posted a net loss of $6 million. For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, the company preliminarily estimates revenue around $4 million, a near‑500% increase, pending confirmation in the formal quarterly report.

A risk is customer concentration. The top three customers account for about 90% of business, with the largest alone representing roughly 68%. Whether capacity can be expanded on schedule and whether the customer base can be diversified will determine how far this growth can go.

Analyst view: In PLC‑based optical switches (WSS), Mordor Intelligence reports that Japan’s NTT Electronics controls over 70% of global capacity, with the remainder largely held by Japanese and Chinese firms. Western majors focus on other technologies such as LCoS and MEMS and, lacking dedicated silicon‑based PLC fabs, invest little in PLCs.

Enablence operates its own PLC wafer fab in California and an assembly line in Vietnam, making it the only North‑American PLC wafer fab taking external orders. This appeals to North‑American cloud providers and optical module makers seeking to reduce geopolitical risk. Therefore, the supply‑demand gap cited in the earnings release is not new information and should not be read as a broad industry demand upgrade.

As early as fiscal 2024, the company secured demand for more than 500 wafers per week while capacity was only 125 wafers per week, creating a severe shortage. The current statement that orders run through mid‑2027 is not new; the speed of revenue growth in this industry depends on how quickly capacity can be ramped up.

By the end of June this year, the company was shipping fewer than 400 wafers per week; it has now increased to about 750 wafers, targeting 1,000 wafers per week by the end of 2026 and 1,200 wafers by June 2027.

The company says that 1,000 wafers per week would generate over $2.5 million of revenue per month, or more than $30 million annually—exceeding the upper end of its full‑year guidance of $21 million. In other words, the guidance reflects the pace of capacity ramp‑up, not a ceiling on demand; the faster capacity expands, the more likely revenue will surpass the guidance.

items.title: 卡車廠的引擎訂單竟有三成來自資料中心？Volvo發電引擎接單年增46%，AI缺電週期正式來臨
items.title_en: A Third of Truck Maker's Engine Orders Come from Data Centers? Volvo's Power Engines See 46% YoY Order Growth, AI Power Shortage Cycle Arrives
paras: 2026年10月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 北美資料中心擴建潮，推升瑞典商用車大廠Volvo集團旗下動力事業Volvo Penta的發電引擎接單動能。Volvo 10月23日公布第三季財報，Penta新接訂單年增46%至11,971台，主要受惠北美資料中心需求；資料中心占季底在手訂單金額比重，由第二季的21%攀升至32%，單季大增11個百分點。
資料中心電力缺口擴大，需求沿著供應鏈向上游延伸。Penta切入的是備援電力供應鏈的引擎端，與發電機組廠及系統整合商合作，將引擎整合進資料中心供電方案；多具引擎可並聯運轉、依負載彈性調度，在電網異常或停電時維持供電。AI基礎建設商機因此不只集中在伺服器與電網設備，也帶動備援發電引擎訂單。

資料中心效益已開始反映在獲利上。公司表示，北美資料中心出貨強勁，抵銷了中東與歐洲需求疲軟。Penta第三季營收53.06億瑞典克朗，年增5%，排除匯率等因素後成長4%；營業利益年增20%至11.19億瑞典克朗，營益率由去年同期的18.6%提升至21.1%，居集團各事業之冠。產品與市場組合優化支撐獲利，但原物料成本上揚抵銷部分增幅。執行長Martin Lundstedt在法說會指出，資料中心業務有助拉升Penta的獲利率。
接單與出貨之間仍有時間落差。Penta第三季引擎出貨9,092台，年減2%，明顯低於11,971台的新接訂單，BB值（訂單出貨比）達1.32。資料中心32%的比重反映的是在手訂單金額，而非當季營收；後續訂單轉為出貨的速度，將決定成長多快反映在營收與獲利上。

優分析觀點：AI建設已經正式面臨缺電
過去市場談AI缺電，多半停留在推估階段，例如用電量將成長多少、電網併網需排隊多久。Penta的財報則讓缺電成為已發生的事實：資料中心占Penta在手訂單金額比重，單季從21%躍升至32%，一家以卡車為主的集團，竟有三分之一引擎訂單來自資料中心。
業者願意砸錢採購發電引擎，代表已不再寄望電網穩定供電。「電網供電跟不上、隨時可能斷電」不再只是隱憂，而是興建資料中心的既定前提，業者因此選擇自建現場發電能力。
這也讓AI資本支出的受惠族群進一步擴大：電力需求不只帶動變壓器與電網設備，也延伸至備援發電，而且獲利貢獻可觀。Penta營收僅年增5%，營業利益卻大增20%，執行長也表示資料中心業務有助拉高獲利率。同樣是賣引擎，資料中心客戶願意支付更高價格，正是產品組合帶動的超額利潤。

paras_en: October 23, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The wave of data‑center expansion in North America is boosting order momentum for power engines at Volvo Penta, the power business of Sweden’s commercial‑vehicle giant Volvo Group. Volvo announced its Q3 results on October 23, showing Penta’s new orders rose 46% year‑on‑year to 11,971 units, mainly driven by demand from North American data centers; the share of data‑center orders in the total order backlog jumped from 21% in Q2 to 32% at the end of the quarter, an increase of 11 percentage points in a single quarter.

The power gap in data centers is widening, pushing demand up the supply chain. Penta targets the engine side of the backup‑power supply chain, partnering with generator manufacturers and system integrators to embed engines into data‑center power solutions; multiple engines can operate in parallel and be flexibly dispatched according to load, maintaining supply during grid disturbances or outages. Thus, AI infrastructure opportunities are not limited to servers and grid equipment but also drive orders for backup power engines.

Data‑center activity is already reflecting in profitability. The company said strong shipments to North American data centers offset weak demand in the Middle East and Europe. Penta posted Q3 revenue of SEK 5.306 billion, up 5% year‑on‑year, or 4% after excluding currency effects; operating profit rose 20% to SEK 1.119 billion, with the operating margin improving from 18.6% a year ago to 21.1%, the highest among the Group’s businesses. Product and market mix optimisation supported earnings, though higher raw‑material costs offset part of the gain. CEO Martin Lundstedt noted at the earnings call that data‑center business helps lift Penta’s profit margin.

There is still a timing gap between orders and shipments. Penta shipped 9,092 engines in Q3, down 2% year‑on‑year, well below the 11,971 new orders, giving a BB ratio (order‑to‑shipment) of 1.32. The 32% data‑center share reflects the value of orders in the backlog, not current‑quarter revenue; the speed at which those orders convert to shipments will determine how quickly growth shows up in revenue and profit.

U‑Analysis view: AI construction is now officially facing power shortages. In the past, market talk about AI power shortages was mostly speculative – estimating how much electricity use would grow or how long grid connections would queue. Penta’s financials turn the shortage into a concrete fact: data‑center orders in the backlog jumped from 21% to 32% in a single quarter, meaning a truck‑focused group now has a third of its engine orders coming from data centers.

Customers are willing to spend heavily on power engines, indicating they no longer rely on stable grid supply. "The grid can’t keep up and outages are possible" is no longer a hidden concern but a given premise for building data centers, prompting operators to install on‑site generation capability.

This also broadens the group of AI cap‑ex beneficiaries: power demand drives not only transformers and grid gear but also backup generation, with sizable profit contribution. Penta’s revenue grew only 5% year‑on‑year, yet operating profit jumped 20%, and the CEO said data‑center business helps raise margins. Selling the same engines, data‑center customers are willing to pay higher prices, delivering excess profit from the product mix.

items.title_en: Solidigm Halts U.S. Plans! SK Hynix Jumps 4.42% but Retail Investors Who Followed Advice Three Months Ago Still Face 75% Losses
paras: SK海力士今(23)日收報每股127.7萬韓元，上漲4.42%，盤中一度下探至117.1萬韓元，隨後震盪翻紅，主要因為該公司宣布暫停旗下美國子公司Solidigm的上市前融資與IPO評估。市場原先擔憂Solidigm單獨赴美掛牌，會因雙重上市折價拖累集團價值，南韓金融委員會前一日也表態將適用雙重上市監管規則，如今計畫喊停，短線緩解估值疑慮。
但支撐股價的回購緩衝已退場。SK海力士周三(21日)提前約一個月完成總額約40兆韓元回購，8月20日以來外資淨賣超25.66兆韓元、法人淨賣超2.68兆韓元。大信證券指出，回購結束不代表股價續跌，但波動將放大。
大約三個月前，SK集團會長崔泰源在濟州島論壇喊出「持有」建議，稱記憶體需求長期向好，但股價自高點回落近60%，當時跟進的散戶成為最大受災戶。
統計顯示，今年4-6月個人投資者淨買入31.5兆韓元，其中6月股價創新高時單月買超15.63兆韓元；7月股價從250萬韓元崩至130萬韓元，散戶仍加碼9兆韓元攤平，最終未躲過虧損。NH投資證券統計，截至10月19日，74.18%的SK海力士持有人處於套牢狀態。
市場目光轉向SK海力士下周三(28日)公布的第三季財報。FnGuide一致預期營業利益達76.964兆韓元，有望創單季新高，但強勁業績已被市場提前反映，真正變數在於股東回報方案。
美林證券測算，按近期收盤價估算，2027年預期本益比僅1.10倍，處於歷史低位。分析師金善宇認為，終止Solidigm上市顯示公司把股東價值置於擴張路線之前，若下周三財報會釋出更具體回報措施，才有機會確認估值窪地、帶動股價實質反彈。
paras_en: SK Hynix closed today (23rd) at 1,277,000 won per share, up 4.42%, after briefly dipping to 1,171,000 won before rebounding. The move was driven by the company’s announcement that it is suspending pre‑IPO financing and listing evaluation for its U.S. subsidiary Solidigm. Earlier market concerns that a separate U.S. listing could drag down group value due to a dual‑listing discount were eased after the Financial Services Commission said dual‑listing rules would apply, and the plan to list has now been called off, temporarily relieving valuation worries.

However, the share‑price support from a buyback has disappeared. SK Hynix completed a roughly 40 trillion‑won repurchase about a month early on Wednesday (21st). Since August 20, foreign investors have net‑sold 25.66 trillion won and institutional investors have net‑sold 2.68 trillion won. Daishin Securities noted that the end of the buyback does not guarantee further price declines, but volatility is likely to increase.

About three months ago, SK Group chairman Choi Tae‑won urged investors at a Jeju Island forum to “hold” the stock, saying memory‑chip demand remains strong in the long run. He noted the share price had fallen nearly 60% from its peak, and retail investors who bought in at that time became the biggest losers.

Statistics show that individual investors net‑bought 31.5 trillion won of SK Hynix shares from April to June this year, including a single‑month net purchase of 15.63 trillion won when the stock hit a new high in June. In July the price fell from 2.5 million won to 1.3 million won, yet retail investors added another 9 trillion won to average down, ultimately still incurring losses. NH Investment & Securities calculated that as of October 19, 74.18% of SK Hynix shareholders were in a loss position.

Market attention now shifts to SK Hynix’s third‑quarter earnings due next Wednesday (28th). FnGuide uniformly expects operating profit of 76.964 trillion won, potentially a quarterly record, but the strong results have already been priced in, leaving the real variable to be the shareholder‑return plan.

Merrill Lynch estimates that, based on the recent closing price, the 2027 forward price‑to‑earnings ratio would be only 1.10×, a historic low. Analyst Kim Sun‑woo believes that terminating Solidigm’s listing shows the company prioritizes shareholder value over expansion, and that only if next Wednesday’s earnings release outlines concrete return measures can the valuation gap be confirmed and the stock see a genuine rebound.

items.title: AI股拋售潮還要跌多久？摩根大通：避險基金多頭部位已大致出清
items.title_en: How Long Will the AI Stock Sell‑off Last? JPMorgan: Hedge‑fund Long Positions Mostly Closed
paras: 《Investing.com》週四 (22 日) 報導，摩根大通指出，隨著投資人自 9 月中旬以來大幅調整股票部位，AI 相關股票的賣壓可能逐漸接近極限。儘管短期逆風仍在，持倉降溫可望開始限制股價進一步下跌的空間。
摩根大通策略師 Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou 在最新報告中表示，該行整體股票持倉指標已明顯低於近期高峰，顯示市場先前偏高的曝險已有所消化。不過，這項判斷主要反映部位調整的進展，並不代表短期波動已經結束。
針對近期引發市場疑慮的新型雲端業者 (neoclouds) 融資問題，摩根大通認為，即使這類業者的融資模式難以持續，也不至於讓整體 AI 資本支出週期脫軌，因為它們在 AI 生態系中的占比仍小，並非不可取代。
根據該行估算，全球上市科技公司今年現金流約為 2.2 兆美元，資本支出約為 1.8 兆美元，其中新型雲端業者分別占約 300 億美元及 800 億美元。
Panigirtzoglou 表示，這意味著，新型雲端業者推動的 AI 基礎設施建置，可由資產負債表更健全、營收來源更多元的科技公司承接，包括大型雲端服務供應商。
從整體資金狀況來看，科技業今年現金流高於資本支出約 4,000 億美元，仍保有融資餘裕。摩根大通指出，科技公司發債，主要是為了在擴大資本支出的同時，維持股票回購。
若融資疑慮進一步蔓延，企業仍可透過延後回購，或增加產業內部的循環融資安排，支應投資需求。Panigirtzoglou 認為，科技業整體現金流足以支應資本支出，代表產業內部仍有資金後盾。
不過，半導體類股仍是潛在波動來源。
摩根大通指出，半導體目前約占全球股市整體風險資本的 1/5，當波動升高時，容易面臨投資人為控制風險而減碼的壓力。
該行研判，避險基金及商品交易顧問 (CTA) 等動能型投資人，可能已大致平倉先前偏高的半導體多頭部位。隨著這波調整逐步完成，相關賣壓可望減輕。
paras_en: Investing.com reported on Thursday (the 22nd) that JPMorgan said the selling pressure on AI‑related stocks may be nearing its limit as investors have dramatically trimmed equity positions since mid‑September. Although short‑term headwinds remain, the cooling of holdings should begin to curb further price declines.

JPMorgan strategist Nikolaos Panigirtzoglou said in a latest note that the firm’s overall equity‑position indicator is now clearly below its recent peak, indicating that the market’s previously elevated exposure has been partially digested. However, this assessment mainly reflects the progress of position adjustments and does not mean short‑term volatility has ended.

Regarding the financing issues of new‑type cloud providers (neoclouds) that have recently raised market concerns, JPMorgan believes that even if these providers’ financing models prove unsustainable, they will not derail the overall AI capital‑expenditure cycle because their share of the AI ecosystem remains small and they are not indispensable.

The bank estimates that global listed technology companies have cash flow of about $2.2 trillion this year and capital expenditures of roughly $1.8 trillion, with new‑type cloud providers accounting for about $30 billion and $80 billion respectively.

Panigirtzoglou noted that this means AI infrastructure projects driven by new‑type cloud providers can be taken over by technology firms with stronger balance sheets and more diversified revenue streams, including large cloud service providers.

Looking at the overall funding picture, the tech sector’s cash flow this year exceeds capital spending by roughly $400 billion, leaving ample financing headroom. JPMorgan said tech companies issue debt mainly to maintain share buybacks while expanding capex.

If financing concerns spread further, companies can still defer buybacks or increase internal circular financing arrangements to meet investment needs. Panigirtzoglou believes the sector’s cash flow is sufficient to cover capex, indicating that internal funding support remains robust.
However, semiconductor stocks remain a potential source of volatility.
JPMorgan pointed out that semiconductors now represent about one‑fifth of total risk capital in global equity markets, and when volatility rises, investors tend to cut exposure to manage risk.

The bank assesses that momentum investors such as hedge funds and commodity‑trading advisors (CTAs) have likely largely closed out their previously oversized long positions in semiconductors. As this adjustment winds down, related selling pressure should ease.

items.title_en: Moon's Dark Side Kimi K3.1 Unveiled! Code Reveals New "Thinking Intensity" Option
paras: 月之暗面旗下 Kimi 官方帳號周五(23)日在 X 與微信影片號發布一段 24 秒預熱影片，畫面中的模型欄位出現「Kimi K3.1」字樣，透露新模型可能即將登場。此前，開源專案 SGLang 的程式碼更新也已出現支援 K3.1 的相關內容。
這段影片以一台老式電腦開場，螢幕上執行的是 Kimi Code。有眼尖網友發現，畫面左上角的模型欄位標示「Model: Kimi K3.1」，成為此次預熱影片的一大焦點。
早在 10 月 19 日，就有網友注意到，SGLang 的一次程式碼提交出現「Kimi-K3.1 support for the K3 chat encoder」標題，相關更新為其實驗性路由元件加入 K3.1 對話編碼支援，提前透露新模型的動向。
從程式碼來看，K3.1 最明確的變化是新增「medium」思考強度。原先 K3 支援 low、high、max 三個等級，K3.1 則在此基礎上加入 medium，讓思考強度多一個選項，路由預設設定仍維持 max。
月之暗面今年 7 月正式發布並開源 Kimi K3，在中國及海外引發討論，不少人將其形容為另一個「DeepSeek R1 時刻」。
近日，由前 Google 首席科學家 Jeff Dean 投資的 AI 新創公司 hillclimb，發布新的基準測試 DeepRSI，專門評估大型語言模型的遞迴自我改進（RSI）與自主科學研究能力。
榜單顯示，Claude Fable 5.1 以 1,548 分排名第一，GPT-6 Astra 以 1,232 分居次。月之暗面旗下擁有 2.8 兆參數的 Kimi K3 則以 820 分排名全球第三，同時拿下中國模型與開源模型第一，成績超越 Grok 4.7 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash。
paras_en: Moon's Dark Side's official Kimi account on Friday (23) posted a 24‑second teaser video on X and WeChat Channels, showing the model field with the label “Kimi K3.1”, hinting that a new model may be arriving soon. Earlier, the open‑source project SGLang’s code update already included support for K3.1.

The video opens with an old computer running Kimi Code on its screen. Sharp‑eyed netizens noticed that the model field in the upper‑left corner reads “Model: Kimi K3.1”, becoming the main focus of the teaser.

Back on October 19, a user pointed out that a SGLang code commit was titled “Kimi‑K3.1 support for the K3 chat encoder”. The update adds experimental routing components with K3.1 dialogue‑encoding support, foreshadowing the new model.

From the code, the most concrete change in K3.1 is the addition of a “medium” thinking intensity. The original K3 supported low, high and max levels; K3.1 adds medium on top of those, giving an extra option, while the routing default remains max.
Moon’s Dark Side officially released and open‑sourced Kimi K3 in July this year, sparking discussion both in China and abroad, with many likening it to another “DeepSeek R1 moment”.

Recently, hillclimb—a AI startup funded by former Google chief scientist Jeff Dean—released a new benchmark called DeepRSI, designed to evaluate large language models’ recursive self‑improvement (RSI) and autonomous scientific research capabilities.

The leaderboard shows Claude Fable 5.1 scoring 1,548 points to take first place, GPT‑6 Astra at 1,232 points in second, and Moon’s Dark Side’s 2.8‑trillion‑parameter Kimi K3 scoring 820 points to rank third globally, while also topping the China and open‑source categories, surpassing Grok 4.7 and Gemini 3.8 Flash.

paras: 2026年10月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SK海力士SK hynix(000660-KR)10月23日宣布，旗下Solidigm停止評估上市前募資及首次公開發行股票(IPO)。近期資本市場波動與半導體股回檔，讓公司重新衡量上市是否符合現有股東利益，但Solidigm的成長前景與投資需求未變，仍將推動擴產。
Solidigm源自SK海力士收購英特爾NAND與SSD業務，目前聚焦AI資料中心使用的高容量企業級固態硬碟(eSSD)。SK海力士表示，既有設施難以充分滿足需求，有必要在美國增加生產設施，IPO原是新廠籌資選項之一。

paras_en: On October 23, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – SK Hynix (000660-KR) announced that its subsidiary Solidigm has stopped evaluating pre‑IPO fundraising and an initial public offering. Recent volatility in capital markets and a pull‑back in semiconductor stocks led the company to reassess whether a listing serves current shareholders, but Solidigm’s growth outlook and investment needs remain unchanged, and it will continue to push expansion.

Solidigm originated from SK Hynix’s acquisition of Intel’s NAND and SSD business and is now focused on high‑capacity enterprise‑grade solid‑state drives (eSSD) for AI data centers. SK Hynix said existing facilities cannot fully meet demand, making it necessary to add production capacity in the United States, with the IPO originally being one financing option for the new plant.

The adjustment this time concerns the financing plan, not the expansion itself. SK Hynix explained on October 1 that the group must simultaneously invest in HBM, server DRAM, and enterprise‑grade SSDs; even with a solid balance sheet, not all investments should be funded solely with internal cash, and external fundraising must balance reducing capital burden with shareholder equity impact.

The company will look for alternative solutions, re‑evaluating investment timing, scale, and financing methods; no new plant investment amount or commissioning date has been disclosed yet. When AI storage demand translates into additional supply will depend on subsequent investment and financing arrangements.

items.title: 毛利率從負16%翻到最高35%！光波導晶片產能訂滿到2027年中，Enablence營收拚年增150%
items.title_en: Gross Margin Flips from -16% to a High of 35%! Enablence’s Photonic Waveguide Chip Capacity Booked Through Mid‑2027, Revenue Set to Jump 150% YoY
paras: 2026年10月23日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 光通訊晶片廠Enablence(ENA-CA)10月22日法說會表示，現有產能已被合約訂滿到2027會計年度底（2027年6月），接下來營收成長要看擴產進度。公司維持9月公布的財測，全年營收1,900萬至2,100萬美元，以中值計算，年增約150%（2026會計年度為810萬美元）。
需求來自AI資料中心。Enablence自行設計並製造平面光波導（PLC）晶片，營收主要來自AI通訊基礎建設，並逐步跨入組裝業務。執行長Todd Haugen表示，資料中心需要更高速、更低功耗的光傳輸方案，客戶需求已超過公司的供應能力。
800G、1.6T光收發模組會用多個波長並行傳輸資料。PLC晶片負責把多路光合成一條光纖送出（多工），到了接收端再拆開（解多工），常見產品是AWG陣列波導光柵。傳輸速度越高、通道越多，對PLC的需求就越大。
產能滿載，也讓獲利結構跟著改善。一方面，產量提高可以分攤固定成本；另一方面，公司把晶圓優先分配給毛利較高的新合約，推升每片晶圓的平均售價。公司預估2027會計年度毛利率25%至35%，上一年度則是負16%。
最新財報已經看得到轉折。2026會計年度第四季（截至6月底）營收290萬美元，年增38%；毛利率8%，連續兩季轉正，但單季仍淨損600萬美元。已結束的2027會計年度第一季，公司初估營收約400萬美元，年增近500%，仍待正式季報確認。
風險在於客戶過度集中。前三大客戶約占九成業務，其中最大客戶就占約68%。擴產能否如期，以及能否分散客戶，將決定這波成長能走多遠。

優分析觀點：營收上限由產能決定，不是訂單
Enablence的供需缺口不是新問題。早在2024會計年度，公司就已取得每週逾500片晶圓的需求，當時產能只有每週125片。現在訂單排到2027年中，代表營收能長多快，取決於產能爬坡速度。
公司於今年6月底每週投片不到400片，目前已拉到約750片，目標2026年底達1,000片、2027年6月達1,200片。
公司表示，每週1,000片可貢獻每月逾250萬美元營收，年化超過3,000萬美元，高於全年財測上緣的2,100萬美元。換句話說，財測反映的是產能爬坡進度，不是需求上限；產能開得越快，營收就越有機會超越財測。

paras_en: October 23, 2026 (Yoo Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Photonic‑communication chip maker Enablence (ENA‑CA) said at its Oct. 22 earnings call that its existing capacity is fully booked through the end of fiscal 2027 (June 2027). Future revenue growth will depend on the pace of capacity expansion. The company sticks to the financial outlook released in September, forecasting full‑year revenue of $19‑21 million, which at the midpoint implies roughly a 150% year‑over‑year increase (FY 2026 revenue was $8.1 million).

Demand comes from AI data centers. Enablence designs and manufactures planar lightwave circuit (PLC) chips in‑house, with revenue mainly derived from AI communication infrastructure and gradually expanding into assembly services. CEO Todd Haugen said data centers need faster, lower‑power optical transmission solutions, and customer demand has already outstripped the company’s supply capability.

800‑Gbps and 1.6‑Tbps optical transceiver modules use multiple wavelengths to transmit data in parallel. PLC chips combine many optical channels onto a single fiber for transmission (multiplexing) and then separate them again at the receiver (demultiplexing). A common product is the AWG (arrayed waveguide grating) grating. The higher the transmission speed and the more channels, the greater the demand for PLCs.

Full‑capacity utilization is also improving the profit structure. Higher volumes spread fixed costs, and the company is allocating wafers first to higher‑margin new contracts, raising the average selling price per wafer. Enablence estimates a gross margin of 25‑35% for fiscal 2027, up from a negative 16% in the prior year.

The latest financials already show a turning point. In Q4 of fiscal 2026 (through June) revenue was $2.9 million, up 38% year‑over‑year, with an 8% gross margin – the second consecutive quarter of positive margin – but the quarter still posted a net loss of $6 million. For the first quarter of fiscal 2027, which has now closed, the company preliminarily estimates revenue around $4 million, a near‑500% year‑over‑year increase, pending confirmation in the formal quarterly report.

The risk lies in customer concentration. The top three customers account for about 90% of business, with the largest alone representing roughly 68%. Whether capacity expansion stays on schedule and whether the customer base can be diversified will determine how far this growth wave can go.

Yoo Analysis view: revenue ceiling is set by capacity, not orders. Enablence’s supply‑demand gap is not new. Back in fiscal 2024 the company already had demand for more than 500 wafers per week, while capacity was only 125 wafers per week. Orders now run through mid‑2027, meaning revenue growth speed depends on how quickly capacity can be ramped up.

The company was shipping fewer than 400 wafers per week at the end of June this year and has now increased that to about 750 wafers per week, targeting 1,000 wafers per week by the end of 2026 and 1,200 wafers per week by June 2027.

Enablence says that 1,000 wafers per week can generate over $2.5 million of revenue per month, or more than $30 million on an annualized basis, exceeding the upper end of its full‑year guidance of $21 million. In other words, the guidance reflects the pace of capacity ramp‑up, not the demand ceiling; the faster capacity comes online, the more likely revenue will surpass the guidance.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。
英鎊兌美元升值0.05%，至1.3401美元。
澳幣兌美元則下跌0.11%，至0.7019美元。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”

U.S. September single‑family home construction fell sharply and future construction permits dropped to a three‑and‑a‑half‑year low. Multiple Iranian officials say they intend to delay talks with the United States to weaken President Trump’s prospects in the November mid‑term elections. Meanwhile U.S. Treasury yields fell, reducing the dollar’s appeal and putting pressure on the greenback on Wednesday. Reuters surveys show most economists expect the Bank of Japan (BOJ) to raise rates to 1.50% in December and keep a quarterly‑hike rhythm. Japan’s government reported September imports and exports grew 18.9% and 16.7% year‑on‑year, respectively, below expectations, but strong demand for semiconductor and AI‑related products kept exports up for a 13th consecutive month while the trade deficit narrowed to ¥536.6 billion. Finance Minister Shunichi Suzuki noted rising import costs are pushing Japanese prices higher and that the economy is entering a wage‑driven, sustained inflation phase. The government will stay in close contact with the BOJ, and both sides see no major disagreement on inflation outlook or policy, supporting yen gains as the USD/JPY pair fell from its ¥158.39 high.

As long‑term Japanese government bond yields continue to rise, they are attracting capital back to Japan. BOJ Deputy Governor Masayoshi Amamiya said higher fuel and raw‑material prices are lifting inflation, and robust global AI demand adds upward pressure on prices. He believes Japan’s core inflation is now close to the BOJ’s 2% target, indicating the central bank is ready to raise borrowing costs, widening the USD/JPY decline to a ¥157.82 low. However, escalating conflict between the United States, Israel and Iran is raising market volatility and fears of energy‑supply disruptions, while falling U.S. crude inventories are supporting higher oil prices, limiting the dollar’s fall. The pair’s resistance is projected at 158.20‑40 and support at 157.30‑50 today.
EUR/USD

RBA Deputy Governor Guy Debelle said yesterday that monetary tightening is slowing the Australian economy, but high oil prices are worsening inflation, leaving him uncertain whether another rate hike will be needed next month. The market now sees roughly a 50% chance of an RBA hike in November, pushing the Aussie dollar to a three‑week high and lifting the euro‑dollar pair from its ¥1.1211 low.

French 10‑year bond yields have risen to their highest level since 2002, highlighting concerns that widespread protests are worsening France’s fiscal fragility and political uncertainty. ECB chief economist Philip Lane said the ECB can bolster the euro’s global standing and expand its policy influence by offering liquidity backstops to foreign markets, helping the euro‑dollar pair reach a ¥1.1240 peak. paras: 美元周三(21日)下跌，交易員評估油價上漲再度引發的通膨風險，並等待聯準會(Fed)下週召開會議。澳幣則因央行官員發表偏緊縮言論而走強。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.14%，報101.65。
加拿大豐業銀行首席外匯策略師Shaun Osborne表示，「目前市場並沒有一個主導全局的明確主題……我認為這種情況至少會持續到下週聯邦公開市場委員會（FOMC）會議前。我們需要了解聯準會的想法。」
美國與伊朗持續交戰，加深了市場對油價推升通膨可能影響聯準會政策的擔憂。
聯邦基金利率期貨交易員認為，聯準會下週升息的可能性不高，下一次升息預計將落在12月。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也不太可能暗示未來的政策走向。
不過，Osborne表示，「我認為，下週市場至少會進一步評估未來升息的可能時間點，相關預期也會變得更加明確。」
投資人也擔心AI交易行情還能持續多久。
儘管上週數據顯示美國9月消費者物價通膨加速，美元仍然走弱。先前市場對AI產業的樂觀情緒吸引資金流入美國，並推升經濟成長與通膨預期，為美元提供支撐。
CIBC Capital Markets外匯策略師Noah Buffam表示，「美國經濟成長很大程度上是由整體AI交易行情所帶動。這也使通膨持續高於目標水準，因此AI對美國的影響比對其他國家更大。」
馬斯克週二表示，合併旗下SpaceX與特斯拉是「一個好主意」，而SpaceX也公布上市以來首次獲利，部分緩解了市場對股市的疑慮。
另一方面，AI伺服器製造商美超微（Super Micro）預估，季營收與利潤率將高於華爾街預期。
歐元兌美元上漲0.01%，至1.1237美元。
法國大規模反政府抗議活動，以及日益惡化的財政前景，持續對歐元造成壓力。法國10年期公債借貸成本週三升至24年來高點。
Saxo全球宏觀策略主管John Hardy表示，「法國的債務問題難以處理。他們確實需要採取適當的財政調整措施，降低債務水準，至少要展現出對債務發展趨勢的重視。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)承諾，將防止上週末的暴動與掠奪事件再次發生。同時，黃背心運動(Yellow Vest)已提出計畫，準備於週六在巴黎舉行大型遊行，這將成為法國政府面臨的下一項重大考驗。
其他貨幣方面，澳洲央行(RBA)副總裁Andrew Hauser在花旗集團一場會議上表示，通膨前景「明顯惡化」，帶動澳幣走強。

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY) tracking the greenback against six major currencies slipped 0.14% to 101.65.

Scotiabank’s chief FX strategist Shaun Osborne said, “There isn’t a clear, dominant theme driving the market right now… I think this will last at least until the FOMC meeting next week. We need to understand the Fed’s thinking.”
The ongoing conflict between the United States and Iran has heightened market concerns that higher oil prices could push inflation up and affect Fed policy.
Federal‑funds futures traders see little chance of a rate hike next week, with the next increase expected in December. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh is also unlikely to signal future policy direction.
However, Osborne added, “I think the market will at least further assess the timing of any future hikes next week, and expectations will become clearer.”
Investors are also worried about how long the AI‑driven market rally can last.

Even though last week’s data showed September U.S. CPI accelerating, the dollar remained weak. Earlier optimism toward the AI sector had drawn capital into the United States, boosting growth and inflation expectations and supporting the greenback.

CIBC Capital Markets FX strategist Noah Buffam said, “U.S. economic growth is largely driven by the overall AI trading rally. That keeps inflation above target, so AI’s impact on the U.S. is greater than on other countries.”
Elon Musk said on Tuesday that merging his SpaceX and Tesla businesses was “a good idea,” and SpaceX reported its first profit since going public, easing some market concerns about equities.
On the other hand, AI server maker Super Micro projected quarterly revenue and margins above Wall Street expectations.
The euro rose 0.01% against the dollar to $1.1237.
Large anti‑government protests in France and a worsening fiscal outlook continue to pressure the euro. France’s 10‑year bond yields rose on Wednesday to a 24‑year high.

Saxo Global macro‑strategy head John Hardy said, “France’s debt problem is hard to solve. They really need to take appropriate fiscal adjustment measures, lower debt levels, and at least show concern for the debt‑development trend.”

French President Emmanuel Macron pledged to prevent a repeat of last weekend’s riots and looting. Meanwhile, the Yellow Vest movement has announced plans for a large march in Paris on Saturday, which will be the next major test for the French government.
Elsewhere, RBA deputy governor Andrew Hauser told a Citi conference that the inflation outlook was “clearly deteriorating,” fueling Australian‑dollar gains.
The Australian dollar rose 0.41% against the U.S. dollar to $0.7031.
The British pound gained 0.16% against the dollar to $1.34. Data showed September UK inflation rose more than expected, strengthening the case for a BoE rate hike in November.
The pound also rose against the euro to its highest level in 17 months.

The yen edged up 0.02% to ¥158.12 per dollar. BoJ deputy governor Ryozo Himino said Japan’s underlying inflation is near the 2% target, the financial environment remains accommodative, and there is still room to raise borrowing costs in the future.

paras: 隨著交易員針對下周即將公布的英國財政預算案進行布局，英鎊對歐元匯率波動的避險成本已攀升至5個月來的新高。
其中，涵蓋預算案公布日期的歐元對英鎊一周隱含波動率一度升至 4.88%，創下 5 月以來的最高水準。一周與三周波動率之間的價差大幅偏向短天期，顯示出強烈的事件風險溢價，創下5個月來最大差距，儘管三周期的選擇權同時涵蓋了英國央行與歐洲央行的利率決策會議。
目前市場投資人高度聚焦於英國的財政前景，以及財政大臣希利(John Healey)將如何平衡政府收支。由於英國今年上半年的政府借款高於預期，推升國家債務總額突破 3 兆英鎊(約 4 兆美元)。
選擇權市場的情緒(反映於風險逆轉指標)顯示，儘管交易員支付更高代價以防範預算案公布期間的大幅波動，但市場仍預期未來一周英鎊對歐元將呈現溫和走強。此外，交易員過去常利用歐元來表達英國特有的風險，但此次歐元自身也已面臨財政與地緣政治壓力。
集保結算公司(DTCC)數據顯示，交易員已透過延伸至預算案公布日後的合約防範英鎊對美元下跌，但對歐元的布局則相對分歧。
在預算案存在不確定性的同時，英國 9 月通膨率因汽柴油價格飆升而創下 11 個月新高，強化了市場對升息的預期，使英國央行處於3年多來首次升息的軌道上。對於央行而言，關鍵在於財政聲明是否會改變通膨前景。
施羅德投資(Schroders)全球經濟主管David Rees對此表示：「市場對預算案的期望雖然不高，但任何顯著的財政刺激措施，都可能增加進口通膨變得更加持久的風險，並迫使英國央行進入更長的緊縮周期。」
paras_en: As traders position for next week’s UK fiscal budget announcement, the hedging cost of GBP/EUR volatility has risen to a five‑month peak.

The one‑week implied volatility of EUR/GBP covering the budget release date briefly spiked to 4.88%, the highest since May. The spread between one‑week and three‑week volatilities swung sharply toward the short end, indicating a strong event‑risk premium and the widest gap in five months, even though the three‑week options also encompass both the Bank of England and European Central Bank rate‑setting meetings.

Market participants are now intensely focused on the UK’s fiscal outlook and how Finance Minister John Healey will balance the government’s books. Borrowing in the first half of the year has exceeded expectations, pushing total national debt past £3 trillion (about $4 trillion).

Options‑market sentiment, reflected in the risk‑reversal indicator, shows that although traders are paying higher premiums to guard against large moves during the budget release, the market still expects a modest GBP strength against the euro over the next week. Historically, traders have used the euro to express UK‑specific risk, but this time the euro itself is also under fiscal and geopolitical pressure.

Data from the Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC) indicate that traders have extended contracts beyond the budget announcement date to hedge against a GBP fall versus the dollar, while positioning on the euro remains more mixed.

Amid budget uncertainty, September UK inflation hit an 11‑month high driven by soaring petrol and diesel prices, bolstering expectations of further rate hikes and putting the Bank of England on track for its first increase in over three years. For the central bank, the key question is whether the fiscal statement will alter the inflation outlook.

David Rees, global head of economics at Schroders, said: “Market expectations for the budget are modest, but any significant fiscal stimulus could make imported inflation more persistent and force the Bank of England into a longer tightening cycle.”

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯同步狂歡！開低走高強勢勁升1.29角收32.488元
items.title_en: New Taiwan Dollar and Stocks Celebrate Together! Opens Low, Rises Strong, Gains 0.129 NTD to Close at 32.488
paras: 打破連四黑，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元今(21)日早盤開低走高，盤中最低貶 8.7 分，午後最高升值1.88角，盤中高低價差達2.75角，匯市多空激烈交戰，終場收在32.488元，升值1.29角，台北外匯成交金額20.59億美元，顯示在熱錢轉向與避險需求交織下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
台幣早盤一度因外資匯出重貶至 32.704 元波段新低，隨台股強彈、外資轉為匯入及相關調節，午後急拉翻紅，終場爆量強升 1.29 角，以 32.488 元作收，終止連四黑。細看匯市全日表現，今日開盤價為 32.630 元，盤中最高升抵 32.429 元、最低貶至 32.704 元，高低價差達 2.75 角。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，受美股科技股財報與半導體族群走強激勵，那斯達克及費城半導體指數持續反彈，帶動亞洲主要股市與貨幣連動上揚。日元、韓元等主要亞幣對美元普遍回升，吸引國際資金重新回流亞洲新興市場，匯市單邊拋匯壓力明顯緩解，促使台北匯市多頭買盤大舉湧現。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據證交所最新統計數據，台股今日受到電子權值股發威帶動，終場大漲 594.84 點，收在 46,887.77 點，成交金額達 8,331.91 億元。
三大法人今日合計買超台股 5.68 億元。其中外資及陸資終結連續 10 個交易日的賣超，回頭買超 9.6 億元；投信則連續 9 個交易日力挺，加碼買超 129.19 億元；自營商仍站賣方調節，賣超 133.11 億元。外資由賣轉買並同步於匯市匯入，帶動股匯雙雙止跌回升。
觀察後續市場演變，匯銀人士分析，外資今日展現強烈回流意願，帶動新台幣一舉化解連續重貶破底的危機。目前新台幣收盤重回 32.50 元大關上方，短線重點將觀察外資買超台股的續航力道以及美國通膨數據、聯準會利率政策動向。若熱錢持續湧入，新台幣不排除進一步向 32.30 元關卡挑戰。
整體而言，投資人宜密切關注美股財報週表現、外資於現期貨市場與外匯市場的資金配置幅度，以及亞幣整體的相對強弱，作為後續投資佈局與資產風險控管的依據。
paras_en: Breaking a streak of four consecutive declines, the New Taiwan Dollar in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market opened lower against the US dollar this morning (21st) but turned higher, falling to a low of 8.7 points before rallying up to 1.88 NTD in the afternoon. The intraday high‑low spread reached 2.75 NTD, reflecting fierce buying‑selling battles, and the session closed at 32.488 NTD, up 1.29 NTD. Taipei’s FX turnover was US$20.59 billion, showing unusually active trading as hot money flows and hedging demand intertwined.

The NT$ briefly slipped to a new intraday low of 32.704 NTD in the early session due to foreign‑capital outflows, but a rebound in the Taiwan stock market, foreign inflows and related adjustments drove a sharp afternoon reversal, ending the day with a strong 1.29 NTD rise to close at 32.488 NTD, ending the four‑day losing streak. Looking at the day’s price action, the opening price was 32.630 NTD, the intraday high was 32.429 NTD, the low was 32.704 NTD, and the high‑low spread was 2.75 NTD.

From the international market and overall environment, US tech earnings and a rally in semiconductor stocks lifted the Nasdaq and Philadelphia Semiconductor indices, which in turn boosted major Asian equity markets and currencies. Major Asian currencies such as the yen and won generally appreciated against the dollar, attracting international capital back to Asian emerging markets. The one‑sided selling pressure in the FX market eased markedly, prompting a flood of bullish buying in Taipei’s foreign‑exchange market.

On the equity side, according to the latest statistics from the Taiwan Stock Exchange, the market was driven by heavyweight electronic stocks, surging 594.84 points to finish at 46,887.77 points with a turnover of NT$8,331.91 billion.

The three major institutional investors bought a net NT$5.68 billion of Taiwanese stocks today. Foreign and mainland investors ended a ten‑day streak of net selling, turning to a net purchase of NT$9.6 billion; investment trusts continued a nine‑day buying streak, adding a net NT$129.19 billion; proprietary traders remained net sellers with a net sale of NT$133.11 billion. The shift of foreign investors from selling to buying, coupled with FX inflows, helped both stocks and the NT$ rebound.

Looking ahead, FX analysts note that foreign investors showed a strong willingness to return today, helping the NT$ quickly resolve the crisis of consecutive sharp depreciations. The NT$ now closed back above the 32.50 NTD threshold; short‑term focus will be on the sustainability of foreign buying in equities, US inflation data, and Fed rate policy. If hot money continues to flow in, the NT$ could further test the 32.30 NTD level.

Overall, investors should closely monitor US earnings reports, the scale of foreign capital allocation in futures and FX markets, and the relative strength of Asian currencies as bases for future investment positioning and asset‑risk management.

paras: ◆USD/JPY

市場權衡美國總統川普簽署豁免對俄羅斯能源出口的部分制裁和關稅，另一方面針對沙烏地阿拉伯與也門的襲擊事件使中東能源供應中斷的擔憂持續存在，導致原油價格重拾漲勢，而且法國騷亂推高對避險資產的需求，提供美元支撐，但路透/益普索民意調查顯示，美國總統川普的支持率跌至31%歷史新低，令美元受阻；此外，被視為日本首相高市早苗再通貨膨脹派盟友之一的經濟財政大臣城內實週二表示，希望出席日本央行(BOJ)本月的政策會議，但尊重BOJ的獨立性，並據四位熟悉BOJ決策思路的消息人士稱，鑒於BOJ上個月剛剛加息，預計其在10月30日結束的政策會議將維持利率不變，但油價上漲給經濟帶來的物價壓力持續比預期更久，BOJ可能在會議結束後發布的季度報告中，上調對下一財政年的通貨膨脹預估，為最早於12月再升息留下空間，而且日本二十年期公債標售投標倍數達5.84倍創紀錄新高，強烈表明觀望資金開始回流，與歐洲政治和財政局勢相比，日本公債開始顯現相對避險資產的吸引力，激勵日圓上漲，美元兌日圓自158.59高點下挫。

隨後美國商務部公布9月建築許可減0.2%至年率為140萬戶高於預期，但房屋開工驟降5.2%至經季節調整年率達122.1萬戶，並據全美住宅建築商協會(NAHB)調查9月成屋待完成銷售指數暴跌7.3%至66.0，創該指數2001年開始編制以來最低，突顯中東衝突推高抵押貸款利率和建築材料價格，打擊房地產市場，衝擊美元兌日圓跌至157.81低點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.30-50，支撐於157.40-60。
◆EUR/USD

澳洲央行(RBA)金融市場主管強調本月28日公布第三季消費者物價指數(CPI)重要性，市場預估核心CPI較前季升1.0%，並較上年同期維持3.6%，遠高於RBA的2%至3%目標，同日紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)可能宣布今年第三次加息，升息25個基點的概率達89%，昨日支撐澳幣和紐元，而且中東衝突推升能源價格，德國9月生產者物價指數(PPI)較前月升1.9%高於預期及較去年同期漲6.7%創三年半新高，推動歐元兌美元自1.1204低點上漲。
據德國經濟研究所ZEW表示，能源價格高企抑制民間消費與投資，10月德國投資者信心指數降至28.1超過預期，但法國動盪局勢緩和及美國數據疲弱，扶助歐元兌美元回升至1.1260高點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1190-1.1210，阻力於1.1270-90。
◆GBP/USD

週二英國公布截至8月的三個月，不含獎金平均薪資較上年同期增3.7%及失業率降至去年中以來最低4.7%，強化英國央行(BOE)於下月會議上調利率至4%的預期，支撐英鎊兌美元穩守1.3296低點。隨著BOE貨幣政策委員會(MPC)委員格林稱，伊朗戰爭引發能源價格衝擊，導致更廣泛通貨膨脹回升風險高於BOE預期，重申利率應上調的觀點，提振英鎊兌美元1.3409高點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3330-50，阻力於1.3430-50。

The market is weighing U.S. President Trump’s signing of exemptions to some sanctions and tariffs on Russian energy exports, while concerns over Middle‑East energy supply disruptions persist after Saudi‑Yemen attacks, pushing oil prices back up. French unrest is also raising demand for safe‑haven assets, supporting the dollar, but a Reuters/Ipsos poll shows Trump’s approval rating has fallen to a historic low of 31%, weighing on the greenback. In addition, Economy and Finance Minister Shiroi, seen as an ally of Prime Minister Kishida’s inflation‑focused camp, said on Tuesday he hopes to attend the Bank of Japan’s policy meeting this month but will respect the BOJ’s independence. According to four sources familiar with BOJ decision‑making, given the BOJ’s recent rate hike last month, the policy meeting ending on Oct. 30 is expected to keep rates unchanged, but higher oil prices are sustaining price pressures longer than expected, so the BOJ may raise its inflation forecast for the next fiscal year in the post‑meeting quarterly report, leaving room for a possible December rate hike. Moreover, the 20‑year Japanese government bond auction saw a record‑high bid‑to‑cover ratio of 5.84, indicating that cautious funds are returning, and compared with Europe’s political and fiscal situation, Japanese bonds are showing relative safe‑haven appeal, bolstering the yen and pulling the USD/JPY down from its 158.59 peak.

Following that, the U.S. Commerce Department reported September building permits fell 0.2% to an annualized 1.4 million, above expectations, while housing starts plunged 5.2% to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of 1.221 million. The NAHB’s September new‑home sales index dropped 7.3% to 66.0, the lowest since the index began in 2001, highlighting how Middle‑East conflict‑driven mortgage rates and construction material costs are hurting the housing market and pushing the USD/JPY down to a low of 157.81. Today’s USD/JPY resistance is projected at 158.30‑50 with support at 157.40‑60.
EUR/USD

The RBA’s head of market operations stressed the importance of the Q3 CPI release on the 28th; the market expects core CPI to rise 1.0% from the previous quarter and to stay at 3.6% year‑on‑year, well above the RBA’s 2‑3% target. On the same day, the RBNZ may announce its third rate hike of the year, with an 89% chance of a 25‑basis‑point increase, which supported the Aussie and Kiwi dollars yesterday. Meanwhile, the Middle‑East conflict is lifting energy prices, and Germany’s September PPI rose 1.9% month‑on‑month, beating expectations and up 6.7% year‑on‑year – a three‑and‑a‑half‑year high – pushing the euro up from its 1.1204 low.

According to Germany’s ZEW institute, high energy prices are suppressing private consumption and investment; the October German investor confidence index fell to 28.1, worse than expected. However, easing turmoil in France and weak U.S. data are helping the euro rebound to a high of 1.1260. Today’s euro support is seen at 1.1190‑1.1210 with resistance at 1.1270‑1.1290.
GBP/USD

Today’s pound support is projected at 1.3330‑1.3350 with resistance at 1.3430‑1.3450.
